company_description: Specialty foundry in Bloomington, Minnesota producing power and analog semiconductors. Now US-majority-owned after Niobrara/Prysm took control from Sanken and Allegro; recipient of a CHIPS Act award to expand domestic capacity.
co_investors: Minnesota Department of Employment and Economic Development
robotnik_take: First binding CHIPS Act commercial fabrication facilities award. $123M direct funding plus $75M from Minnesota Forward Fund anchors expansion of 200mm analog/power/sensor capacity. Sets the legal-binding template for subsequent Q4 2024 finalizations.

company_description: Designs and manufactures CPUs, AI accelerators, and other semiconductors, and operates Intel Foundry to provide leading-edge fabrication services to external customers. Public on NASDAQ (INTC); CHIPS Act awards including a Secure Enclave program for US government and defense use.
lead_investors: U.S. Department of Defense / U.S. Department of Commerce
robotnik_take: Up to $3B finalized binding award for Intel's Secure Enclave program to manufacture leading-edge semiconductors for US government/defense use. Separate from Intel's broader $7.86B commercial CHIPS award (finalized November 2024). Reflects DoD-Commerce convergence on trusted foundry policy. Public co (NASDAQ: INTC).

company_description: Korean fabless designer of AI inference NPUs (ATOM, REBEL) for data center and edge applications. Merged with rival FuriosaAI to consolidate Korea's AI chip industry; manufactures at Samsung Foundry.
robotnik_take: First Korean startup investment by Aramco's $500M Wa'ed Ventures, signaling MENA sovereign capital pivoting toward Asian AI chip alternatives. Extension to January 2024 $124M Series B; Rebellions later merged with Sapeon (December 2024) to form Korea's first AI chip unicorn.

company_description: UK Oxford spinout designing in-memory compute AI inference chips for accelerating frontier-model inference at lower power than GPUs. NATO Innovation Fund is a strategic investor.
lead_investors: Kindred Capital, NATO Innovation Fund, Oxford Science Enterprises
co_investors: Cocoa, Innovia Capital
robotnik_take: UK in-memory compute startup (Oxford spin-out) targeting frontier-model inference acceleration. NATO Innovation Fund participation is notable as a defense-aligned signal in AI compute. Founder Walter Goodwin pursuing radically different architecture vs GPU.

company_description: Develops chiplet die-to-die interconnect IP including its NuLink technology, which competes with the UCIe standard. Strategic backing from SK hynix and Samsung positions Eliyan in the chiplet ecosystem.
robotnik_take: Strategic investment from VentureTech Alliance pushed Eliyan past $100M cumulative funding for chiplet die-to-die interconnect IP. Amount undisclosed but extends the $60M March 2024 Series B. NuLink/UCIe-class IP play with strategic SK hynix and Samsung backing.

company_description: Swedish manufacturer of GaN-on-SiC epitaxial wafers using its proprietary QuanFINE structure. Supplies wafers to telecom, aerospace, and defense customers; Wallenberg-backed Navigare is a strategic investor.
co_investors: Wafer Works, RFHIC, Ignite Innovation, BRV Capital Management, Lifelike Capital
robotnik_take: Swedish GaN-on-SiC epitaxial wafer specialist; QuanFINE structure differentiates vs conventional buffer layers. Wallenberg-backed Navigare leading expansion of capacity for telecom/aerospace/defense GaN demand. Notable cross-border syndicate (Sweden, Taiwan, Korea, US).

company_description: Bangalore-based fabless designer of surveillance camera SoCs targeting the enterprise and consumer surveillance market. Founded by ARM, Intel, and Broadcom veterans; first reference chip on UMC 28nm.
robotnik_take: Bangalore-based fabless surveillance SoC startup, founded by ex-ARM/Intel/Broadcom veterans. Targets enterprise/consumer surveillance camera market with 28nm UMC reference chip in Q1 2025. Indicative of India's emerging fabless ecosystem under semiconductor mission policy.

company_description: Chinese fabless designer of automotive autonomous driving SoCs for ADAS and L2+/L3 vehicles. Public on HKEX (02533); manufactured by TSMC. Xiaomi is a strategic investor.
robotnik_take: First Chinese autonomous-driving SoC designer to list on Hong Kong Exchange (02533.HK). Raised HK$1.036B (~$132M) at HK$28/share but plunged ~33% on debut, reflecting cooling Chinese auto-chip narrative. Xiaomi-backed; TSMC-linked supply chain.

company_description: Develops a general-purpose robot foundation model — a single AI 'brain' designed to work across different robot bodies. Pittsburgh-based; targets robot OEMs and integrators that want to license the underlying control intelligence rather than build it in-house.
lead_investors: Lightspeed Venture Partners, Coatue, SoftBank Group, Bezos Expeditions
co_investors: Felicis Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Menlo Ventures, General Catalyst, CRV, SV Angel, Carnegie Mellon University, Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund, Alexa Fund
robotnik_take: Foundation model play for general-purpose robotics emerging from stealth. Investor list (Lightspeed/Coatue/SoftBank/Bezos plus the Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund) signals belief that physical-AI is the next foundation-model frontier and that the brain - not the body - is where capital should concentrate.

company_description: Builds autonomous surface vessels (Spyglass and Cutlass classes) for the US Navy. Founded by former Navy SEAL Dino Mavrookas; targets maritime unmanned systems as a follow-on category to aerial defense autonomy. (Same company as Saronic; this row covers earlier funding rounds.)
co_investors: 8VC, Caffeinated Capital, Elad Gil, NightDragon
robotnik_take: Defense ASV play hits unicorn status three years after founding; a16z lead and the speed of step-up reflects DoD's pivot to attritable autonomous platforms post-Ukraine. Maritime is the underweighted leg of the unmanned defense thesis vs UAS.

company_description: Builds autonomous defense systems and the Lattice software platform that links sensors, communications, and weapons across battlefield domains. Products include the Roadrunner counter-drone interceptor, Ghost surveillance UAV, and Dive autonomous undersea vehicle. Sells primarily to U.S. and allied militaries.
co_investors: Fidelity Management & Research, Counterpoint Global, Baillie Gifford, Altimeter Capital, Franklin Venture Partners
robotnik_take: Largest defense-tech round of 2024 ahead of Arsenal-1 mass production buildout. 65% valuation step-up from $8.5B (Dec 2022) on a reported revenue doubling to ~$500M; 28x revenue is rich but reflects pricing of US re-armament against a peer adversary.

company_description: Develops AI software and autonomous systems for European defense, including a strike-drone family and software that processes sensor data for situational awareness. Sells to NATO ministries of defense with primary customers in Germany, the UK, France, and Estonia.
co_investors: Accel, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Plural, Greenoaks Capital Management, Elad Gil
robotnik_take: European answer to Anduril; €450M at €4.95B valuation marks Europe's first credible defense-AI unicorn at scale. Round announced same month as Saronic and a few weeks before Anduril Series F — the AI-defense capital cycle peaked in Q3 2024.

company_description: Builds electric autonomous tractors for orchards, vineyards, and dairy operations. Sells direct to specialty-crop and dairy farmers along with a paired data and software platform.
co_investors: At One Ventures, PMV, Welvaartsfonds
robotnik_take: Largest-ever ag-robotics raise; signals that vertical-specific autonomy (orchards/vineyards/dairy) is commercially proven before general-purpose AV economics work. Astanor lead is a tell — impact pools see ag autonomy as scale-deployable today.

company_description: Builds a software-defined warehouse automation platform using climbing robots that move heavy material in three dimensions. Founded by former Tesla engineers; competes with Symbotic, AutoStore, and Exotec in ASRS.
co_investors: Eclipse Ventures, Abstract Ventures, Promus Ventures, 515 Ventures, Garry Tan, Lachy Groom
robotnik_take: Ex-Tesla Optimus head Chris Walti's stealth raise targets ASRS reinvention with climbing robots in a 3D grid. $78M cumulative across rounds; warehouse automation continues attracting AI-native founders chasing Symbotic-scale outcomes.

company_description: Builds the RO1 6-axis collaborative robot arm with a demonstration-based programming interface. American cobot manufacturer targeting reshoring of US manufacturing; Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund is a strategic investor.
co_investors: Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund, Samsung Next, Lachy Groom, Quiet Capital, Box Group, Zeno Partners
robotnik_take: American cobot-arm manufacturer betting on US reshoring; Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund participation suggests fulfillment use cases. Demonstration-based programming pitch positions Standard Bots against Universal Robots/Doosan on UX rather than price.

company_description: Builds the DrinkBot automated beverage-dispensing system for quick-service restaurants. Strategic customer and investor Jollibee anchors commercial deployments in the QSR channel.
robotnik_take: Strategic round led by existing customer (Jollibee); suggests commercial traction is real but signals lock-in/QSR-channel-only risk. Beverage-bot category is narrow; defensibility is supply chain integration not robotics IP.

company_description: Builds robotic systems for automated pathology tissue processing — slicing and slide preparation for histology labs. Strategic health-system investors include Northwell, Mayo, Ochsner, and Columbia University.
co_investors: CU Healthcare Innovation Fund, Mayo Clinic, Ochsner Ventures
robotnik_take: Health-system strategic syndicate (Northwell/Mayo/Ochsner/CU) signals pull-through commercial demand for pathology automation amid pathologist shortage. Adjacent to surgical robotics on lab side — represents an under-covered automation pocket within healthcare.

company_description: Develops a neurovascular surgical robot (Vasco platform) for stroke care, with a telesurgery component to address geographic access constraints in stroke thrombectomy.
co_investors: Cormorant Asset Management, Mirae Asset Capital
robotnik_take: Neurovascular surgical robot for stroke care — underserved category vs soft-tissue surgical-robotics consolidation around Intuitive/Medtronic. Telesurgery angle is strategic for stroke (geographic access constrains thrombectomy outcomes).

company_description: Builds camera-only autonomous mobile robots, originally for sidewalk delivery and now pivoting toward indoor industrial automation. Strategic investors include Magna, Shell, and Mitsubishi Electric.
co_investors: Magna International, Shell Ventures, Mitsubishi Electric
robotnik_take: Strategic-heavy investor list (Magna, Shell, Mitsubishi Electric) suggests pivot from food delivery to industrial/indoor automation. Cartken's camera-only AV stack gives auto-tier-1s a low-cost on-ramp to mobile robotics IP.

company_description: Operates a mobile beverage manufacturing platform — modular packaging cells that can be relocated. Strategic customer and lead investor Schreiber Foods anchors the initial deployment.
co_investors: Tech Council Ventures
robotnik_take: Mobile manufacturing platform with first customer Schreiber Foods leading the round; classic strategic-led seed-extension structure. Mobile/modular automation is an under-explored format relative to fixed-cell robotics deployment.

company_description: Develops the Pathfinder endoluminal robotic platform for gastrointestinal endoscopy. Strategic investor Olympus brings GI distribution; spinout of Jupiter Endovascular consolidates the company around GI.
lead_investors: Sonder Capital, Olympus Corporation of the Americas
co_investors: Existing and new undisclosed investors
robotnik_take: Olympus strategic lead is the headline — the GI endoscopy incumbent buying optionality on robotics-assisted Pathfinder. Spin-out of Jupiter Endovascular suggests Neptune is consolidating around GI; Fred Moll as Chairman validates the platform.

company_description: Swiss manufacturer of VTOL commercial mapping drones. WingtraOne survey UAV is the flagship product; targets surveying, mining, and construction users wanting fixed-wing range with vertical takeoff.
co_investors: Brick & Mortar Ventures, Spectrum Moonshot Fund, SymbiaVC
robotnik_take: Series B1 extension for VTOL surveying drone — profile is more commercial mapping than defense-aligned. Capital efficiency relative to recent defense-drone megarounds; VTOL geometry is the right form-factor for commercial wide-area sensing.

company_description: Swiss ETH Zurich spinout building a wheeled-quadruped robot — a four-legged robot with wheels on each foot — for last-mile delivery, security, and inspection. Later rebranded to RIVR.
co_investors: Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund, Armada Investment, Linear Capital
robotnik_take: Wheeled-quadruped form factor is a credible alternative to bipedal humanoids for last-mile/security/inspection. Bezos plus HongShan plus Amazon's Industrial Innovation Fund signals the same Bezos-Amazon thesis hitting both Skild and Swiss-Mile in one quarter. Later rebranded to RIVR.

company_description: Builds a tractor-mounted pyrolysis robot that converts agricultural residue into biochar in the field, generating verifiable carbon-removal credits. Climate funds Microsoft and Grantham anchor the cap table.
co_investors: Congruent Ventures, Grantham Foundation, Microsoft Climate Innovation Fund
robotnik_take: Tractor-mounted pyrolysis robot for biochar carbon removal — vertically-narrow ag-robotics with carbon-credit revenue stream stacked on hardware. Climate-pool LPs (Microsoft, Grantham) substitute for traditional growth equity at this stage.

company_description: First well-funded Korean humanoid robotics company. Hyundai's ZER01NE participation positions Holiday as Korea's national-champion humanoid challenger to Boston Dynamics (Hyundai-owned) and Apptronik.
lead_investors: Atinum Investment, Stonebridge Ventures, SpringCamp, ZER01NE Ventures
co_investors: Intervest, Hyundai Motor ZER01NE
robotnik_take: First well-funded Korean humanoid play; Hyundai's ZER01NE participation positions it as Korea's national-champion challenger to Boston Dynamics (Hyundai-owned) and Apptronik. KRW round — large by Korean seed standards.

company_description: US humanoid robotics startup founded by Sankaet Pathak (formerly of fintech Synapse, which filed for bankruptcy in 2024). Developing general-purpose humanoid platforms.
co_investors: Undisclosed angels
robotnik_take: Founder credentialing risk: Sankaet Pathak's Synapse fintech filed for bankruptcy 2024. Tribe self-leading is unusual; humanoid-robotics has become a magnet for displaced fintech operators chasing the next platform shift.

company_description: Builds self-propelled autonomous battery-electric railcars as retrofits for existing freight rail networks. Operating commercial deployments at the Iron Senergy mine in Pennsylvania.
co_investors: Advantage Capital, Cathcart Rail, Idealab
robotnik_take: Self-propelled autonomous battery-electric railcar retrofit play; addresses the most under-automated transport mode (rail). Already in revenue at Iron Senergy mine — one of the few autonomy plays with active commercial deployment vs demos.

company_description: Chinese humanoid robot company building the SE01 platform at a unit cost below $14,000. Founded by former XPeng Robotics engineers.
robotnik_take: Sub-$14k unit-cost humanoid (SE01) targeting commercial deployment within months — Chinese cost curve continues to undercut Western humanoids by ~5-10x. Founding team ex-XPeng Robotics; auto-OEM diaspora pattern continues.

company_description: Develops the AutoDrive autonomous ground vehicle stack for military logistics and combat support vehicles. Sells autonomy kits and retrofits to the US Army and allied ground forces.
lead_investors: Moore Strategic Ventures, XYZ Venture Capital, Hedosophia
co_investors: Standard Investments, Enlightenment Capital, Crescent Cove Advisors, Four More Capital
robotnik_take: Dual-use autonomy stack already on DoD program of record (ROGUE Fires) — revenue is real, not vaporware. Kalmar partnership for autonomous yard trucks adds civilian leg. 2.5x oversubscription reflects the defense-AV thesis being hot.

company_description: Builds a handheld robotic device for ultrasound-guided needle placement, FDA 510(k)-cleared for commercial use. Targets a much larger procedure TAM than capital-intensive surgical robot platforms; chaired by Fred Moll of Intuitive Surgical.
co_investors: Lux Capital, PFM Health Sciences, Fred Moll
robotnik_take: Handheld robot for ultrasound-guided needle placement with FDA 510(k) already in hand — de-risked on regulatory and reimbursement. Fred Moll involvement is the dominant signal in surgical robotics; targets a much larger TAM than capital-intensive da Vinci-style systems.

company_description: Builds autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) and tow tractors for warehouse and manufacturing material handling. Customers include Giant Eagle and other US distribution operators.
lead_investors: Giant Eagle Incorporated, G2 Venture Partners
co_investors: Existing shareholders
robotnik_take: Customer-led inside round (Giant Eagle); warehouse AMR market consolidating around incumbents with deployed fleets. Series D from existing investors only is a sign capital efficiency is improving but the new investor base is thin.

company_description: Builds FAA-approved electric autonomous aircraft for agricultural spraying and military cargo delivery. Commercial customers include Dole and Embraer; defense customers include Sierra Nevada and Skyports.
co_investors: Piva Capital, Prelude Ventures, Metaplanet Holdings, Y Combinator
robotnik_take: Dual-use FAA-approved electric autonomous aircraft — already commercially flying (Dole, Embraer, Sierra Nevada, Skyports). The defense/agriculture wedge with revenue today is rare; commercial-ag traction provides the manufacturing scale defense customers need.

company_description: Builds the Vector reconnaissance UAS — a fixed-wing vertical-takeoff drone for tactical intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance. Sells to European militaries including the German Bundeswehr; active in Ukraine in combat use.
robotnik_take: Series B extension brings total round above €100M. Porsche SE participation is meaningful — German industrial money pivoting into defense/dual-use after Zeitenwende. VTOL drone form factor competes with Wingtra commercially and Helsing on defense. Note: also has Nov-25 Series C extension entry.

company_description: Builds open-architecture small unmanned aircraft systems for defense and a secure software-delivery pipeline for UAS code accreditation. RTX Ventures is a strategic investor.
co_investors: Crosslink Capital, RTX Ventures, Stellar Ventures
robotnik_take: Open-architecture UAS plus secure-software-delivery pipeline play. RTX Ventures participation is the strategic tell — Raytheon's prime-contractor angle on small-UAS code accreditation.

company_description: UK developer of accelerated physics simulation software for robotics training, founded by former NVIDIA simulation engineers. Provides foundation-model training infrastructure for embodied AI companies.
co_investors: Factorial Funds, Samsung Next, Tru Arrow, Xora, IQ Capital, Koro Capital, Concept Ventures, Lakestar Scout Fund
robotnik_take: Ex-Nvidia simulation engineers commercializing accelerated physics for robotics training. The picks-and-shovels layer to the foundation-model boom (Skild et al.) is becoming investable on its own.

company_description: Develops L4 autonomous trucking software targeting the Houston-San Antonio commercial freight corridor. Founded by TuSimple co-founder Xiaodi Hou; pursues a capital-light approach versus Aurora and Plus.
co_investors: Cherubic Ventures, EnvisionX Capital, First Star Ventures, Linear Capital, M31 Capital, Taihill Venture, Uphonest Capital, Welight Capital
robotnik_take: Founded by ex-TuSimple co-founder Xiaodi Hou; second-generation autonomous trucking play targeting Houston-San Antonio commercial freight in 2025. Capital-light approach vs Aurora/Plus suggests a different go-to-market thesis on autonomy unit economics.

company_description: French developer of software-only 3D-vision robot guidance, sold as a plug-in to industrial robot arms. Customers include Ford, Whirlpool, Thyssenkrupp, and Atlas Copco; Exor (Agnelli/Stellantis vehicle) is a strategic investor.
co_investors: MIG Capital
robotnik_take: Software-only 3D-vision robot guidance; Exor (Agnelli/Stellantis vehicle) lead implies strong auto-tier-1 deployment. Customer list (Ford, Whirlpool, Thyssenkrupp, Atlas Copco) shows real industrial traction at Series A.

company_description: Chinese autonomous mobile robot (AMR) manufacturer for warehouse and logistics applications. Exporting to Europe, Southeast Asia, Japan, and Korea alongside Geek+ and Hai Robotics.
lead_investors: Golden Oriole Capital, FarGlory Group, Wuxi Liangxi Technology Innovation Fund, Weifang Yuanfei Industrial Fund
robotnik_take: Largest Chinese AMR raise of Q3; over $100M USD primarily for international expansion (Europe/SEA/JP/KR). Quicktron, Geek+, and Hai Robotics are now the three Chinese AMR exporters competing with Western incumbents on price.

company_description: Norwegian manufacturer of unmanned surface vessels (USVs) for offshore HSE, survey, and environmental monitoring. Civilian USV focus distinct from defense-aligned peers like Saronic and HavocAI.
co_investors: Umoe, Holta Invest, employees and existing shareholders
robotnik_take: Norway's leading USV maker with growth capital led by Nordic cleantech (NRP Zero) and the state climate fund. The 'civilian' USV thesis (offshore HSE/survey) parallels but is distinct from Saronic/HavocAI defense ASV bets.

company_description: Korean force-torque sensor manufacturer for collaborative robots and humanoid platforms. CJ Logistics and POSCO are strategic investors anchoring deployment-led demand from Korean conglomerates.
co_investors: POSCO Investment, CJ Logistics, Samsung Next, GS Ventures, DSC Investment, BNK Venture Investment, Kolon Investment, FuturePlay
robotnik_take: Force-torque sensor specialist — the unsexy but critical layer for cobots and humanoids. CJ Logistics and POSCO participations indicate deployment-led demand from Korean conglomerates. Sensor-component plays often outperform full-stack at scale.

company_description: Builds autonomous surface vessels across four size classes from 14 to 100 feet for US Navy and DoD missions. Backed by In-Q-Tel; competes with L3Harris and Textron in unmanned maritime systems.
co_investors: Outlander VC, The Veteran Fund, BVVC, Decisive Point, Alumni Ventures, New North Ventures
robotnik_take: Low-cost-attritable USV play — a Saronic-lite at the seed stage. Cluster of US ASV startups in 2024 (Saronic Series B, HavocAI seed, Maritime Robotics) reflects DoD's surface-vessel autonomy gap.

company_description: UK Scottish developer of AI-powered food packing robotics. Has packed over 1 million bags in production at food processors; backed by Scottish National Investment Bank.
co_investors: Mercia Ventures, WA Capital
robotnik_take: AI-powered food packing robotics with state-bank-led growth funding (Scottish NIB). Niche food-picking automation but already 1M+ bags packed proves operational maturity. Vertical-AI robotics thesis hitting in less-obvious geographies.

company_description: German developer of hospital mobilization robotics for ICU and rehabilitation patients, claimed to reduce rehab time by around 20%. Backed by the EIC Fund.
co_investors: TQ-Group, Henrik Schunk, Stephan Huber, EIC Fund
robotnik_take: Hospital mobilization robotics for ICU/rehab — reduces rehab time by ~20%. EIC Fund cornerstone follows established pattern of European deep-tech medtech using public co-investment to bridge clinical commercialization.

company_description: Israeli developer of robotic piece-picking systems using a hybrid gripper combining vacuum, adhesive, and finger gripping. ZIM Ventures (shipping line) is a strategic investor.
co_investors: InNegev, Fusion VC, Israel Innovation Authority, ZIM Ventures
robotnik_take: ZIM Ventures (corporate VC of major shipping line) participation hints at maritime-supply-chain pull-through for piece-picking. Hybrid gripper approach (vacuum + adhesive + finger) is technically differentiated vs Covariant/Berkshire Grey single-gripper bets.

company_description: Chinese humanoid robot company building bipedal and quadrupedal robots for general-purpose legged locomotion. SAIC-backed Shang Qi is a strategic investor. (Same company as LimX Dynamics/Zhuji Dynamics.)
lead_investors: China Merchants Capital, Shang Qi Capital
co_investors: Fengrui Capital, Oasis Capital, Ming Shi Capital
robotnik_take: SAIC-backed Shang Qi participation makes LimX a quasi-strategic OEM-aligned humanoid play, similar to AgiBot/SAIC backing pattern. Amount undisclosed; included for completeness as a high-profile Chinese humanoid round in Q3 2024.

company_description: Beijing-based developer of research-grade humanoid robots at a price point below $5,000. Targets the research and education market, backed by Beijing municipal robotics funds.
lead_investors: Piwan Times, MinBank International, Zhongguancun Science City, iCANX Fund
co_investors: Inno Angels (existing)
robotnik_take: RMB 100M Pre-A for sub-$5K research-grade humanoid. Beijing state ecosystem (Zhongguancun) backing reflects municipal robotics funds (Beijing's $1.4B robotics fund launched Jan 2024) deploying capital. Research/edu market is differentiated vs industrial humanoid plays.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of quadruped robots (Lynx, X20) and an emerging humanoid product line. Sells industrial inspection and service robots in domestic and international markets; competes with Boston Dynamics, Unitree, and ANYbotics.
robotnik_take: Series B+ extension; amount undisclosed. Quadruped specialist now pivoting toward humanoid/embodied-AI per company statements. Included as a notable Chinese robotics raise in window despite undisclosed terms.

company_description: Manufactures productized 100 kg-class Aries satellite buses on a serial production line in Los Angeles. Customers include Orbit Fab, Ubotica, and defense primes; competes with York Space Systems and Loft Orbital in standardized smallsat platforms.
co_investors: Upfront, 8VC, Toyota Ventures, Point72 Ventures, Mirae Asset Capital, Outsiders Fund, GSBackers, Andreessen Horowitz, Shield Capital, J2 Ventures, Ravelin, Baiju Bhatt, Avalon Capital Group
robotnik_take: Productized satellite bus manufacturer (Aries platform). Tier-1 a16z + CRV + Toyota syndicate signals satellite-OEM commoditization is now investable.

company_description: Develops active phased-array communications payloads for satellites and aircraft, including the Vireo Ka-band antenna and the Skylark satcom terminal. L3Harris is a strategic investor in the defense satcom segment.
co_investors: Development Bank of Japan, Quanta Computer, Kleiner Perkins, Lavrock Ventures, L3Harris Technologies, InMotion Ventures, Matter Venture Partners, MESH Ventures, Assembly Ventures
robotnik_take: Active phased-array communications payloads (Vireo Ka-band, Skylark satcom terminal). Series B+ brings total Series B to $125M; L3Harris strategic continues defense satcoms consolidation thesis.

company_description: Japanese operator of a synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite constellation. Sells SAR imagery and analytics to government, disaster response, and infrastructure-monitoring customers.
lead_investors: Japan Growth Capital Investment Corporation (Nomura SPARX Investment)
co_investors: JAFCO Group, Mizuho Capital, other institutional and individual investors
robotnik_take: SAR satellite constellation operator. Native Y7B raise — relatively modest by global standards but supports JAXA's small-launch ecosystem.

company_description: Chinese small satellite manufacturer (also known as Beijing Weina Star Technology) supplying spacecraft for the country's LEO constellation buildout. Mass-manufactures buses and integrated satellites for state and commercial constellation customers.
co_investors: Chinese institutional investors (undisclosed)
robotnik_take: Chinese small satellite manufacturer (Beijing Weina Star Technology); Y1B raise to scale design and mass-manufacturing infrastructure for the broader China LEO push. Date approximated to mid-June 2024 — exact day not in English sources.

company_description: Provides space situational awareness and orbital data products by fusing telescope, radar, and on-orbit sensor data. Co-founded by Steve Wozniak; acquired Orbital Insight in 2024 to expand its data-analytics stack.
co_investors: Lux Capital, BOKA Group, Starburst Ventures, Winklevoss twins
robotnik_take: Space situational awareness and orbital data; round announced concurrent with acquisition of Orbital Insight. Steve Wozniak co-founder; pivot to data-fusion is a strategic narrative shift from physical SSA hardware.

company_description: Operates the world's largest commercial synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite constellation. Sells imagery and analytics to defense, intelligence, and insurance customers, with growing NATO-aligned demand for all-weather, day-and-night earth observation.
co_investors: Move Capital Fund I, Blackwells Capital, Christo Georgiev
robotnik_take: Sovereign Solidium leads SAR-leader's growth round; oversubscribed at Eur86M. Note: also has Dec-24 Series D extension entry; entity_id shared.

company_description: Holding entity for Astroscale, a Japanese in-orbit servicing and space debris removal pioneer. Public on Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market following a 2024 IPO.
robotnik_take: Space debris removal and in-orbit servicing pioneer; IPO priced at top of range (Y850/share); shares closed +51% on debut at ~$995M market cap. First major orbital-services pure-play public listing.

company_description: Operates in-space manufacturing satellites that produce pharmaceutical and materials products in microgravity and return them to Earth in reentry capsules. The same reentry capsules also serve as hypersonic test beds for the US Air Force and NASA.
co_investors: Lux Capital, General Catalyst, Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures
robotnik_take: Microgravity pharmaceutical manufacturing; W-1 capsule landed Feb 2024. Pure-play in-space manufacturing thesis bank-rolled by deep-tech generalists.

company_description: Spanish launch vehicle company developing MIURA 5, a small reusable launcher for European commercial and government missions. Mitsubishi Electric is a strategic investor anchoring Asian customer access.
co_investors: Includes PERTE (Spanish government program contributions)
robotnik_take: Spanish small launch developer (Miura 1 / Miura 5); Eur78M mixed equity + PERTE government contributions. Funds Elche rocket factory expansion.

company_description: Develops Spectrum, a small-to-medium-lift launch vehicle for European institutional and commercial payloads. Targets sovereign European launch capacity from Andoya Spaceport in Norway.
co_investors: G3T, 10x Group, Besant Capital, Finadvice, LP&E, Lakestar, Earlybird Venture Capital, Airbus Ventures, Bayern Kapital, UVC Partners
robotnik_take: Spectrum small launcher developer; brings total Series C to >Eur220M. NATO Innovation Fund participation is the strategic tell — European sovereign defense capital backing indigenous launch.

company_description: UK developer of the Prime small launcher, with launch operations planned from Sutherland Spaceport in Scotland. Scottish state bank is a strategic investor.
co_investors: Octopus Ventures, BGF, Heartcore
robotnik_take: UK Prime small launcher; Scottish state bank lead anchors Sutherland Spaceport launch operations. Capital efficiency vs continental peers but small ticket — execution risk on first launch.

company_description: French in-orbit servicing company offering life extension for geostationary satellites through rendezvous and docking. Competes with Northrop Grumman MEV and Astroscale in commercial satellite servicing.
co_investors: EIC Fund, IRDI Capital Investissement, Space Founders France (CNES)
robotnik_take: GEO satellite life-extension servicing (Endurance vehicle). EIC Fund + Space Founders cornerstone reflects French sovereign-tech industrial policy spreading to space-services layer.

company_description: Telemetry observability software platform for mission-critical machines including spacecraft. Customer base is space-heavy with Astranis, K2 Space, and True Anomaly using the platform; software product rather than space hardware.
co_investors: Riot Ventures, Caffeinated Capital, Conviction Embed
robotnik_take: Telemetry observability platform for mission-critical machines including spacecraft. Customer base is space-heavy (Astranis, K2, True Anomaly) but product is software — borderline category.

company_description: Spanish operator of an industrial IoT satellite constellation providing direct-to-device LEO IoT connectivity for asset tracking and remote monitoring.
lead_investors: Nabtesco Technology Ventures, Indico Capital Partners
co_investors: Newmind Venture, Sabadell Venture Capital
robotnik_take: Industrial IoT satellite constellation (direct-to-device LEO IoT). Date approximated to early-June; exact day not in English sources.

company_description: Builds radioisotope power systems using strontium-90 as the heat source for satellites, lunar landers, and undersea infrastructure. Targets locations where solar power is unavailable or unreliable.
co_investors: Seraphim Space, Balerion Space Ventures, JAWS, Vanderbilt University, RiverPark Ventures, Stage 1 Ventures, 7i Capital, Beyond Earth Ventures
robotnik_take: Radioisotope (Sr-90) power systems for satellites, lunar landers, and undersea infrastructure. Dual-use space/defense thesis; complements broader nuclear-onboard-power renaissance.

company_description: Chinese commercial launch company also known as Beijing Tianbing Technology. Developing Tianlong-3, a Falcon 9-class reusable medium-lift rocket, alongside the smaller Tianlong-2.
robotnik_take: Beijing Tianbing Technology — Tianlong-3 reusable Falcon-9-class rocket. Y1.5B extension reflects Chinese commercial-launch capital re-engaging despite the Tianlong-3 static fire mishap (June 30, 2024).

company_description: Manufactures Titan Silicon, a silicon-based anode material that replaces graphite in lithium-ion battery anodes for higher energy density. Targets EV-volume production with cells used by automotive OEMs; operates a manufacturing plant in Moses Lake, Washington.
lead_investors: Sutter Hill Ventures, T. Rowe Price
co_investors: Bessemer Venture Partners, Coatue, Perry Creek Capital
robotnik_take: Silicon-anode battery materials; Titan Silicon for EV production. Sutter Hill + T. Rowe Price lead at $375M signals continued institutional belief that silicon anodes will scale to mass auto markets despite multiple peer failures in 2024.

company_description: German lithium-ion battery recycling company building industrial-scale recovery of cobalt, nickel, lithium, and graphite from end-of-life cells. Strategic backing from Porsche and Bosch anchors automotive offtake.
co_investors: Bosch Ventures, DeepTech & Climate Fonds, NRW.Venture, Vsquared Ventures, Speedinvest, 10x Founders
robotnik_take: Largest-ever European battery recycling Series A. Porsche + Bosch corporate backing signals German auto-supply-chain urgency on lithium-ion recycling capacity.

company_description: Recycles lithium-ion batteries using its LPAS (low-temperature plasma-assisted separation) direct-recycling process that recovers cathode material without breaking it down to raw metals. Strategic investors include Samsung, Honda, and LKQ.
lead_investors: Samsung Venture Investment Corporation, Helium-3 Ventures
co_investors: Honda Motor, LKQ Corporation, SCG Group, Traxys Group, Wistron
robotnik_take: Direct lithium-ion battery recycling using LPAS (low-temp plasma-assisted separation). Heavy strategic syndicate (Samsung, Honda, LKQ) signals battery-recycling market consolidating around OEM pull-through.

company_description: MIT spinout commercializing a porous-silicon membrane platform for recovering critical metals from mining waste and end-of-life batteries. BHP Ventures is a strategic investor anchoring mining offtake.
co_investors: BHP Ventures, Extantia, Orion Industrial Ventures, Azolla Ventures, E14 Fund
robotnik_take: Porous-silicon membrane platform for critical-metals recovery from mining waste. BHP Ventures participation signals mining-major pull-through; MIT spinout. Borderline Battery Materials (recycling use case).

company_description: Develops a capillary-fed alkaline electrolyzer for low-cost green hydrogen production. Strategic backing from bp Ventures and POSCO anchors heavy-industry offtake.
co_investors: IP Group Australia, Kiko Ventures, Virescent Ventures (CEFC), Hostplus, Vestas Ventures, BlueScopeX, POSCO Holdings, POSCO E&C, IMM Investment, Shinhan Financial Group, Oman Investment Authority IDO
robotnik_take: Capillary-fed alkaline electrolyser for green-hydrogen — largest Australian cleantech Series B in history. bp Ventures + POSCO corporate strategics signal heavy industry's commitment to electrolyser cost-curve. Borderline subsector — closer to industrial energy than materials.

company_description: Modular Layer-1 blockchain protocol for decentralized physical infrastructure networks (DePIN). Hosts DePIN projects on its native IOTX token and invests proceeds into its DePIN portfolio.
lead_investors: SNZ Capital, Foresight Ventures, FutureMoneyGroup, Borderless Capital
co_investors: Amber Group, Metrics Ventures, EV3, Waterdrip Capital
robotnik_take: Modular DePIN L1; strategic round with proceeds allocated to long-term staked IOTX and IoTeX-based DePIN portfolio investments. Token-denominated structure rather than pure equity but named syndicate disclosed.

company_description: Decentralized zero-knowledge proof verification network running as an EigenLayer AVS (actively validated service). Provides a coprocessor compute layer for Ethereum applications needing ZK proof verification.
co_investors: DAO5, L2Iterative, Nomad Capital, FinalityCap, Symbolic VC, Theta Capital
robotnik_take: EigenLayer AVS providing decentralized ZK-proof verification — coprocessor compute layer for Ethereum. Borderline category: closer to crypto infra/ZK middleware than pure AI-DePIN.

company_description: Parallelized confidential computing network on Solana combining multi-party computation (MPC), fully homomorphic encryption (FHE), and zero-knowledge primitives. Targets encrypted-data computation as a Web3 primitive.
co_investors: Coinbase Ventures, Heartcore Capital, Longhash VC, L2 Iterative Ventures, Staking Facilities, Smape Capital, Everstake
robotnik_take: Parallelized confidential-computing network combining MPC, FHE & ZK; encrypted-data compute infrastructure on Solana. Strong signal that confidential-compute primitives are getting investable as standalone DePIN.

company_description: Decentralized AI research and training platform that aggregates distributed compute for collaborative AI model creation. Targets the open-source AI and decentralized training intersection.
co_investors: Compound, Collab+Currency, Protocol Labs, Clem Delangue (Hugging Face)
robotnik_take: Decentralized AI research/training platform aggregating distributed compute for collaborative AI model creation. Hugging Face + Protocol Labs angel involvement signals OSS-AI / decentralized-training intersection.

company_description: Decentralized messaging and communication protocol with edge-compute and end-to-end encryption. Communications-layer DePIN serving Web3 messaging needs.
co_investors: Balaji Srinivasan, Web3.com Ventures, Galxe, SWC Global, Gabby Dizon (YGG)
robotnik_take: DePIN messaging/communication protocol with edge-compute and end-to-end encryption. Communications DePIN rather than compute DePIN — borderline classification.

company_description: Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) powered privacy compute network for AI data. Targets confidential AI inference as a Web3 primitive.
co_investors: Laser Digital (Nomura), Tanelabs (SoftBank-backed), Binance Labs
robotnik_take: FHE-powered privacy compute network for AI data — DePIN AI infra. Strategic tranche on top of $5M seed (Mar 2024); total round $9.75M.

company_description: Develops end-to-end embodied AI driving models that learn driving behavior from data rather than hand-coded rules. Licenses its self-driving stack to automakers and operates ride-hail pilots in the U.K., Germany, and the U.S.
co_investors: NVIDIA, Microsoft, Eclipse Ventures
robotnik_take: Largest AI/AV financing in Europe to date; embodied AI for end-to-end self-driving across many OEM platforms. Anchors SoftBank's physical-AI thesis alongside Arm.

company_description: Self-driving subsidiary of General Motors. Operated robotaxi services in several US cities before suspending operations after a 2023 pedestrian incident; GM later wound down robotaxi development and refocused Cruise's technology on consumer ADAS in late 2024.
robotnik_take: Captive equity from parent GM to keep Cruise solvent post-pedestrian-incident shutdown; not a pure-VC private round but disclosed publicly. GM later (Dec 2024) cut robotaxi funding entirely.

company_description: Develops autonomous driving software for robotaxi services, originally as a Hyundai-Aptiv joint venture. Hyundai acquired Aptiv's stake in 2024 and absorbed Motional into its captive autonomous mobility stack.
robotnik_take: Hyundai injected $475M of fresh capital alongside acquiring Aptiv's stake; combined commitment near $1B reflects Aptiv's de-risking from robotaxi capex.

company_description: Develops AI-powered autonomous driving software for Class 8 freight trucks and robotaxis. Uses a simulation-first generative AI approach for training and validation, distinct from heavy-real-world-fleet competitors. Founded by Uber ATG's former chief scientist.
co_investors: NVIDIA, Volvo Group Venture Capital, Porsche Automobil Holding SE, Scania Invest, Ingka Investments
robotnik_take: Generative-AI-first autonomous trucking; round backed by carmaker strategics across Volvo, Porsche, Scania. Crucial validation of Waabi's simulator-led approach versus Aurora and Kodiak.

company_description: Software-defined-vehicle and autonomous driving software arm of the Hyundai Motor Group. Builds the unified software stack and autonomous mobility platform across Hyundai and Kia vehicles.
robotnik_take: Korean autonomy/SDV unit absorbed W253B of additional capital from Hyundai/Kia. Captive equity round consolidating Hyundai's in-house autonomy stack alongside Motional and Boston Dynamics.

company_description: Stealth household-robotics venture founded by Kyle Vogt, the former CEO of Cruise. Developing consumer home robots; product details and timing remain undisclosed.
lead_investors: Nat Friedman, Daniel Gross, Spark Capital
co_investors: Quiet Capital, Patrick Collison, John Collison, Elad Gil, Fifty Years
robotnik_take: Outsized seed for ex-Cruise CEO Kyle Vogt's stealth household-robotics venture; remarkable seed quantum reflects founder pedigree premium typical of 2024's physical-AI moment.

company_description: Designs, builds, and operates vertiports — ground infrastructure for eVTOL aircraft and air taxis. Joint development partnerships with Joby Aviation and the Dubai Roads & Transport Authority.
co_investors: Groupe ADP
robotnik_take: Vertiport infrastructure for eVTOL (Joby/Dubai RTA tripartite). Drone services + air-taxi infrastructure adjacent to autonomous systems; subsector boundary fuzzy.

company_description: Builds software-defined manufacturing cells for electronics assembly, combining robotics with computer vision and a manufacturing software platform. NVIDIA and Microsoft are strategic investors aligning the platform with their AI infrastructure work.
co_investors: NVIDIA, Microsoft, Eclipse Ventures, Jabil, Shinhan Securities
robotnik_take: Software-defined manufacturing with direct NVIDIA/Microsoft strategic involvement; signals AI-stack convergence with electronics assembly. Excludes $20M J.P. Morgan venture-debt tranche from equity figure.

company_description: Builds a collaborative robot platform (Proxie) for healthcare and logistics environments. Founded by Brad Porter, former VP of Amazon Robotics; partnered with Mayo Clinic on hospital deployments.
co_investors: Bison Ventures, Industry Ventures, Lux Capital, Sequoia Capital, Khosla Ventures, Mayo Clinic, Neo, 1984 Ventures, MVP Ventures, Calibrate Ventures
robotnik_take: Brad Porter's (ex-Amazon Robotics) stealth cobot company; healthcare/retail/logistics deployments. Major early-stage validation of non-humanoid mobile manipulation.

company_description: Chinese humanoid robot developer building general-purpose embodied AI platforms for industrial and service applications. Backed by China Mobile's Industry Chain Leader Fund; competes with Agibot, Unitree, and Tesla Optimus.
lead_investors: Meituan, BAIC Industrial Investment, SenseTime Guoxiang Fund, iFlytek Fund
co_investors: Qiming Venture Partners, BlueRun Ventures (Lanchi), Matrix Partners China, Source Code Capital, IDG Capital
robotnik_take: Record angel-round size for Chinese embodied-AI sector at time of closing; wheeled-bipedal humanoid building on Peking University Wang He's lab. Proxy for Beijing's strategic embrace of household humanoids.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of collaborative and industrial robotic arms built on a shared xCore platform. Backed by China's national manufacturing fund as part of the country's industrial-robotics push.
lead_investors: National Manufacturing Transformation and Upgrading Fund
co_investors: Zoucheng City New Kinetic Energy Industry Investment Fund
robotnik_take: Strategic+ round from China's national manufacturing fund; cobot/industrial robotic arms with shared xCore platform. Government-backed industrial-policy capital, not pure VC.

company_description: Japanese developer of Autoware, an open-source autonomous driving software stack used by automotive OEMs and AV startups globally. Strategic investors include Suzuki and other Japanese OEMs consolidating around Autoware for L4 development.
co_investors: Aisin, Yamaha Motor, JIC Venture Growth Investments
robotnik_take: Open-source Autoware AV stack adds Suzuki to Series B at Y8.5B; consolidates Japan's L4 supply chain with multiple OEMs co-investing.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of indoor commercial cleaning robots for offices, retail, and hospitality environments. Reported its first year of corporate profitability, a notable milestone for service-robot economics.
robotnik_take: Indoor cleaning robots; cumulative Series D total reached $50M after this strategic top-up. Gausium claims first-time corporate profitability — significant validation for service-robot economics.

company_description: Provides Robot-as-a-Service for high-mix manufacturing surface treatment — robotic sanding, polishing, and finishing operations. Targets aerospace, defense, and consumer-goods manufacturers.
co_investors: NGP Capital, Euclidean Capital, Advance Venture Partners, SQN Venture Partners, 3M Ventures, B Capital, Bow Capital, Calibrate Ventures, OCA Ventures, Swift Ventures
robotnik_take: Robot-as-a-Service for high-mix manufacturing surface treatment (sanding, polishing). Wellington's first growth-equity check signals robotics moving from VC to crossover funds.

company_description: Chinese surgical robotics company developing the Carina robotic-assisted surgery (RAS) modular system. Founded by veterans of Intuitive Surgical and Auris Health, targeting the Chinese market against Versius, Toumai, and Edge.
co_investors: King Star Med LP, LongRiver Investments
robotnik_take: Modular Carina laparoscopic surgical platform; targeting NMPA approval and 2025 commercialization. Reflects continuing Chinese capital into domestic surgical robotics despite global slowdown.

company_description: Israeli defense-tech company building a tactical drone operating system and combat drones. Battle-tested with the Israel Defense Forces in Gaza and under US Department of Defense contracts.
co_investors: Clal-Tech
robotnik_take: Defense-tech drone OS battle-tested with IDF in Gaza and US DoD contracts; combat-validation a clear catalyst. Round priced after operational deployment, not before.

company_description: Builds self-driving forklifts and pallet movers for distribution centers and manufacturing facilities. Vertical-specific AMR play targeting material handling and yard pickup automation.
co_investors: Proficio Capital Partners, IMPULSE
robotnik_take: Closes Series C at $100M (extension of 2022 round). Self-driving forklift / pallet-mover plays directly into the autonomous yard / DC pickup automation thesis. Note: also has Nov-24 row.

company_description: NASA spinout building robotic systems that digitize paper documents at scale, combined with software for indexing and AI-enabled workflows. Sells to enterprises and government agencies digitizing legacy records.
co_investors: Icon Ventures, Lux Capital, MUIP, 15th Rock, FUJIFILM Business Innovation
robotnik_take: NASA-spinout robotic document digitization; 72% revenue growth in 2023. Bridges robotics and document/genAI workflows for enterprise — niche but growing category.

company_description: Chinese supplier of the PhiGo binocular stereo-vision radar for ADAS and autonomous driving. Targets the Chinese 'stereo-vision-as-cheap-LiDAR' ADAS approach competing with traditional radar and LiDAR vendors.
robotnik_take: Binocular stereo-vision radar (PhiGo) for ADAS/autonomy; Series B (also called Pre-B) financing mass manufacturing scale-up. Reflects China's stereo-vision-as-cheap-LiDAR ADAS thesis.

company_description: Develops autonomous middle-mile delivery trucks for short-haul B2B freight between warehouses and retail stores. Isuzu is a strategic investor and committed to dedicated L4 autonomous truck production starting in 2027.
robotnik_take: Strategic equity from Isuzu commits to dedicated Level 4 autonomous truck production facility starting 2027 — first OEM/AV company joint mass-production commitment in the sector.

company_description: Provides Robotics-as-a-Service for small and mid-sized manufacturers, with Mitsubishi HC Capital co-funding the entire RaaS lifecycle. Targets the US SMB manufacturing automation gap.
co_investors: Mitsubishi HC Capital America, NEC, Translink Orchestrating Future Fund, Alumni Ventures, FJ Labs, Lux Capital, Initialized Capital, Lorimer Ventures
robotnik_take: RaaS model for SMB manufacturers; Mitsubishi HC Capital co-funding the entire RaaS lifecycle is a notable commercial structure. Total Series A now $52M+.

company_description: Develops maritime collision-avoidance AI software for commercial ships. Demonstrated the first autonomous commercial ship voyage in congested waters; sells to shipping operators pursuing autonomous and remote-operated vessels.
co_investors: Ankona Capital Partners, Santa Barbara Venture Partners, Playfair Capital
robotnik_take: Maritime collision-avoidance AI; claims first autonomous commercial ship voyage in congested waters. Proxy for shipping-decarbonization driven autonomy adoption.

company_description: Dutch developer of an autonomous robotic phlebotomy device for blood draws. Targeting CE Mark in Europe with hospital pre-orders; one of the few examples of fully autonomous medical robotics outside surgery.
co_investors: Invest-NL, European Innovation Council Fund
robotnik_take: Autonomous robotic phlebotomy device; targeting CE Mark by end-2024 with European hospital pre-orders. Niche example of fully autonomous medical robotics outside surgery proper.

company_description: Builds a 'drone-as-first-responder' platform for police and fire departments, automating dispatch and reducing 911 response times to under 90 seconds. Acquired by Flock Safety in 2024.
co_investors: Andreessen Horowitz, Karman Ventures, Immad Akhund, Ford Street Ventures
robotnik_take: Drone-as-First-Responder for police/fire; reduces 911 response time to ~86 seconds. Subsequently acquired by Flock Safety (2024) — already a strong strategic outcome.

company_description: Builds robotic ADAS sensor calibration equipment for vehicle repair shops, automating the post-collision recalibration of cameras and radar. Insurer investors include Allstate and Liberty Mutual.
co_investors: Lux Capital, Construct Capital, Haystack Ventures, Allstate Strategic Ventures, Liberty Mutual Strategic Ventures
robotnik_take: Robotic ADAS sensor calibration for repair shops; insurer participation (Allstate, Liberty Mutual) signals service-network plays for AV/EV maintenance economics.

company_description: Israeli developer of an AI-vision precision-spraying retrofit kit that integrates with commercial sprayer brands. Claims around 88% reduction in herbicide use; sells to row-crop growers.
co_investors: Syngenta Group Ventures, JVP, Orbia Ventures, Eyal Waldman, Iron Nation, Amol Deshpande
robotnik_take: AI-vision precision spraying retrofit kit cuts herbicide use 88%; integrates with any commercial sprayer brand. Capital-light agritech robotics versus full robot OEMs.

company_description: Builds mechanized prescribed-fire vehicles and aerial-ignition drones for wildfire prevention. Customers include PG&E and tribal forestry departments; insurer and climate-tech investors anchor the cap table.
co_investors: Toyota Ventures, AmFam Ventures, Convective Capital, Blue Forest Asset Management, Skip Capital, Overture Ventures, Lowercarbon Capital, Pathbreaker Ventures
robotnik_take: Mechanized prescribed-fire and aerial-ignition drone systems for wildfire prevention. PG&E and Hoopa Valley deployments; insurer + climate-VC capital stack.

company_description: Danish lab automation company building robotic systems that automate the visual assay-imaging step in biology R&D workflows. Sells to pharma and biotech researchers.
co_investors: R7, ACME, Y Combinator, Nicholas Francis, Per Falholt, 21stBio
robotnik_take: Lab-automation robotics for biology R&D — automates the visual assay-imaging step. One of the largest lab-automation Series As in Europe.

company_description: Builds construction robots that install solar power plant arrays following the natural contour of the land. Claims around double energy yield per acre through terrain-following installation versus flat fixed-tilt sites.
robotnik_take: Construction robots for solar power plant deployment; doubles energy yield per acre via terrain-following arrays. Robotics intersect with the energy-deployment bottleneck.

company_description: Israeli humanoid robot company building MenteeBot, a humanoid platform that uses camera-only sensing (no LiDAR). Chaired by Mobileye founder Amnon Shashua.
co_investors: Hookipa AG, Doron Sagie
robotnik_take: MenteeBot humanoid; Mobileye founder Amnon Shashua chairs. Camera-only sensing technology stands in contrast to most US humanoids using LiDAR. Round preceded company de-cloak.

lead_investors: Madrona Venture Group, Innovation Endeavors, Bison Ventures
robotnik_take: Drone-mapping plus autonomous rock-pickers for farms. Niche but defensible — TAM dominance approach for the $2.7B rock-management market.

company_description: Builds underground delivery networks ('hyperlogistics') — small-bore tunnels with autonomous shuttles moving packages and food orders. Operating a 0.7-mile production network in Peachtree Corners, Georgia.
co_investors: Cortado Ventures, Myelin Ventures
robotnik_take: Underground delivery network ('hyperlogistics'); 0.7-mile production network already in Peachtree Corners. Speculative but distinctive logistics-robotics infrastructure thesis.

company_description: German developer of a modular palletizing and machine-tending collaborative robot platform aimed at SMB manufacturers. Targets the German Mittelstand market.
co_investors: SquareOne Venture Capital, Picus Capital, Mirko Novakovic
robotnik_take: Modular palletizing/machine-tending cobot platform aimed at SMB manufacturers; reflects European robotics-as-platform model serving the Mittelstand.

company_description: French spine surgery robotics and navigation company. Strategic partner Spineart provides distribution and clinical channel; founded by Stephane Lavallee (founder of MedTech and Praxim).
robotnik_take: Strategic equity from Spineart for spine-surgery robotics/navigation; Stephane Lavallee (founder of MedTech, Praxim) leads. Tight strategic round, not financial VC.

company_description: Swiss manufacturer of actively-tethered autonomous drones for first responders. Tethered architecture avoids battery and BVLOS regulatory limitations for sustained over-scene awareness.
co_investors: Swisscanto Private Equity Growth I, Credit Suisse Entrepreneur Capital
robotnik_take: Actively-tethered autonomous drones for first responders — niche but proven category that avoids battery and BVLOS limitations.

company_description: Builds NDAA-compliant FPV combat drones for the US Army and allied militaries. Operates a Los Angeles factory producing kamikaze and reconnaissance drones at scale; sells primarily into the defense channel.
co_investors: Peter Thiel, A*, D3, Long Journey Ventures, BoxGroup
robotnik_take: Founder-led drone startup (drone-racers) supplying Ukraine; explicitly non-Chinese supply chain at low-four-figure unit economics. American Dynamism thesis play.

company_description: Builds off-road autonomous ground vehicles for defense using the OverDrive autonomy software stack, demonstrated at 45 mph in unstructured terrain. Holds DARPA RACER Phase II and an $18.6M Army Other Transaction agreement.
co_investors: Shasta Ventures, Ascend VC, Pioneer Square Labs, Voyager Capital, Cubit Capital
robotnik_take: Off-road autonomous ground vehicles for defense; OverDrive software up to 45 mph in unstructured terrain. DARPA RACER Phase II + $18.6M Army OT in parallel.

company_description: German developer of the modular GEREON unmanned ground vehicle series for defense applications. The first publicly disclosed investment by the NATO Innovation Fund.
co_investors: Discovery Ventures, Project A Ventures
robotnik_take: Largest European DefenceTech seed at the time; modular GEREON UGV series. NATO Innovation Fund's first publicly disclosed deployment.

company_description: Builds autonomous cleaning and maintenance drones for commercial buildings — primarily window-washing and pressure-washing drones — and industrial structures. Sells to building services and facility operators.
co_investors: Idea Fund Partners, Danu Venture Group, Y Combinator Growth Fund, Gratus Capital
robotnik_take: Sherpa exterior cleaning drone + Lavo Bot pressure-washer; domestic US drone manufacturing economics beat overseas shipping. Niche but profitable category.

company_description: Builds an AI fire-control system that turns standard rifles into counter-drone weapons. Niche dual-use defense product; a16z American Dynamism portfolio company.
robotnik_take: AI fire-control system that turns standard rifles into counter-drone weapons; a16z American Dynamism thesis play. Niche dual-use defense robotics.

company_description: Canadian designer of force and torque sensors for surgical, logistics, humanoid, and space robotics. Picks-and-shovels supplier for the touch-sensor stack underlying dexterous manipulation.
lead_investors: Brightspark Ventures, BDC Capital Deep Tech Venture Fund
co_investors: Garage Capital, MaRS IAF, EmergingVC
robotnik_take: Force/torque sensors for surgical, logistics, humanoid, and space robotics — picks-and-shovels for the touch-sensor stack underlying dexterous manipulation.

company_description: Builds AI-powered self-serve vision-testing kiosks that produce 90-second eyeglass prescriptions. Targets retail and consumer health channels.
co_investors: Humba Ventures, Ravelin, Spacecadet, Baukunst, Village Global
robotnik_take: AI-powered self-serve vision-testing kiosk; 90-second eyeglass prescriptions. Subsector boundary fuzzy (AI medical device, not surgical robot per se).

company_description: Builds robotic ike-jime fish processing systems that automate the traditional Japanese technique to triple shelf life. Targets specialty seafood processors and high-end restaurant supply.
co_investors: 8VC, Impatient Ventures, Susa/Humba Ventures, Carya Venture Partners, Ravelin Capital, Red & Blue Ventures, Undeterred Capital
robotnik_take: Robotic ike-jime fish processing — automates centuries-old technique to triple shelf-life. Vertical-specific robotics with built-in pricing power versus commoditized fish.

company_description: Canadian operator of autonomous 'dark' microfactories at grocery distribution centers. Targets the labor and logistics layer of last-mile food supply chains through vertically integrated robotic micro-production.
co_investors: i4 Capital, Waterpoint Lane, RGS Ice
robotnik_take: Autonomous 'dark' microfactories at grocery distribution centers; first such facility in Canada. Robotics applied to vertically-integrated last-mile food supply chains.

company_description: Israeli developer of Gary, a two-armed hospital service robot deployed at Rabin Medical Center and Shamir Medical Center for non-clinical task automation.
co_investors: Avishai Abrahami, Micha Kauffman
robotnik_take: Two-armed hospital service robot 'Gary' deployed at Rabin Medical Center and Shamir Medical Center. Service-robot adjacent to humanoid form factor.

company_description: UK University of Glasgow spinout building a miniaturized ultrasonic scalpel for robotic-assisted surgery. Targets the surgical robotics ecosystem with a smaller-footprint energy device.
co_investors: Maven Capital, SIS Ventures, Scottish Enterprise, Innovate UK Biomedical Catalyst
robotnik_take: Miniaturized ultrasonic scalpel for robotic-assisted surgery; combines $4M of equity + IUK grant. University of Glasgow spinout.

company_description: French manufacturer of hydrogen-powered airship drones for long-endurance infrastructure inspection. Aircraft has a 10-hour flight time and 350 km range using fuel-cell propulsion.
lead_investors: Y Combinator, Ring Capital, Kima Ventures, Collaborative Fund
co_investors: Marc Tarpenning
robotnik_take: Hydrogen-powered airship drones for long-endurance infrastructure inspection (10h, 350km). Niche but technically distinctive given fuel-cell aviation thesis.

company_description: Lithuanian defense startup building battlefield-tested drone swarms with battle management system integration. Part of the Eastern European defense-tech wave alongside Helsing and ARX Robotics.
co_investors: 8 angel/syndicate investors, Vytenis Buzas, Ernestas Kalabuckas
robotnik_take: Battlefield-tested swarm drones with BMS integration; Lithuanian first-satellite founders. Eastern European defense-tech wave alongside Helsing/ARX.

company_description: Builds the LaserWeeder, an autonomous farm implement that uses computer vision and high-powered lasers to kill weeds in row crops without herbicides. Sells to specialty-crop growers; claims significant cost reduction versus chemical weed control.
robotnik_take: Strategic NVentures top-up to Series C; amount estimated at $10M (precise figure undisclosed). AI laser-weeder; precedes the $70M Series D in October 2024.

company_description: Israeli fabless designer of edge AI accelerator chips, including the Hailo-10 generative AI accelerator. Targets automotive, industrial, smart cameras, and consumer devices needing on-device inference.
co_investors: Zisapel family, Gil Agmon, Delek Motors, Alfred Akirov, DCLBA, Vasuki, OurCrowd, Talcar, Comasco, Automotive Equipment, Poalim Equity
robotnik_take: Edge AI accelerator chips; debuted Hailo-10 GenAI accelerator alongside the round. Brings total raised to $340M. Insider-only round signals limited new institutional appetite at the prior valuation.

company_description: Designs the MLSoC, a machine-learning system-on-chip for embedded edge AI applications. Second-generation MLSoC supports multimodal generative AI at the edge; targets industrial, robotics, and automotive customers.
co_investors: Point72, Jericho Capital, Amplify Partners, Dell Technologies Capital, Fidelity Management & Research, Lip-Bu Tan
robotnik_take: Embedded edge AI MLSoC platform. Funds support 2nd-gen MLSoC for multimodal GenAI. Note: also has Q4 2024 entry.

company_description: Designs energy-efficient ASICs for Bitcoin mining and zero-knowledge proof acceleration. Founded by alumni of Cavium and Palo Alto Networks; competes with Bitmain and MicroBT in mining hardware with a US-based design house.
lead_investors: StepStone Group, Top Tier Capital Partners, MVP Ventures, Maverick Capital
co_investors: Celesta Capital, Mayfield Fund, Marathon Digital
robotnik_take: Bitcoin-mining ASIC chip designer (Teraflux) and blockchain/AI infrastructure. Round was oversubscribed; $60M equity + $20M debt. Borderline Frontier Compute.

company_description: Israeli designer of embedded on-chip memory IP for low-power semiconductors. Licenses memory IP cores to chip designers.
co_investors: HackCapital, Silicon Catalyst Angels, Claves Investments, undisclosed strategic semiconductor company
robotnik_take: On-chip memory IP for low-power chips. Borderline EDA & IP classification.

company_description: Designs a server CPU and GPGPU accelerator based on the RISC-V instruction set, manufactured on TSMC 3nm, targeting AI and data analytics workloads. Competes with x86 (Intel, AMD) and ARM-based server silicon on a license-free ISA bet.
co_investors: MediaTek, Intel Capital, Koch Disruptive Technologies
robotnik_take: RISC-V CPU + GPGPU accelerator for AI / data analytics on TSMC 3nm. Intel Capital and MediaTek participation reflect ecosystem hedging on RISC-V plus AI integration.

company_description: Develops a fault-tolerant photonic quantum computer using silicon photonics manufactured on standard CMOS processes. Operates a cryogenic R&D facility in Daresbury, UK developing the high-power dilution refrigeration systems needed to scale to million-qubit machines.
lead_investors: Australian Commonwealth Government, Queensland State Government
robotnik_take: Equity + grants + loans package to build utility-scale fault-tolerant photonic quantum computer in Brisbane by 2027. Sovereign-backed quantum bet at industrial scale.

company_description: Korean fabless designer of on-device AI semiconductors (DX-V1, DX-V3, DX-M1, DX-H1) for vision, robotics, and AI server applications. Part of the Korean fabless ecosystem maturing alongside Rebellions and FuriosaAI.
co_investors: AJU IB, Timefolio Asset Management, BNW Investments
robotnik_take: On-device AI semiconductor (DX-V1, DX-V3, DX-M1, DX-H1) for vision, robotics, AI servers. Korean fabless ecosystem maturing alongside Rebellions/FuriosaAI.

company_description: Korean fabless designer of CXL-based memory and compute architecture chips. Rebranded as XCENA in December 2024; targets memory-compute disaggregation in AI and data center workloads.
lead_investors: SV Investment, STIC Ventures, LB Investment, Industrial Bank of Korea
co_investors: Mirae Asset Venture Investment, Mirae Asset Capital, IMM Investment, SBI Investment, Tony Investment, Wonik Investment Partners
robotnik_take: Fabless CXL-based memory/compute architecture; rebranded XCENA in Dec 2024. Korean memory-compute startup riding CXL standard adoption.

company_description: Korean developer of a no-code EDA tool for design and optimization of power and clock systems in complex SoCs. Part of the AI-for-EDA category.
robotnik_take: No-code EDA tool for design and optimization of power and clock systems in complex SoCs. Niche but timely AI-for-EDA play.

company_description: Designs customizable Neural Processing Unit (NPU) IP for edge AI inference, licensed to chip designers. indie Semiconductor is a strategic investor anchoring automotive Tier 1 distribution.
robotnik_take: Customizable Neural Processing Unit (NPU) IP for edge AI inference. indie Semi strategic lead unusual — IP-licensing model with auto-tier-1 strategic.

company_description: Spanish developer of hardware IP cores (GenAI v1) for accelerating generative AI inference on FPGAs. Licenses IP to FPGA and ASIC designers.
robotnik_take: Hardware IP core for accelerating generative AI inference on FPGAs (GenAI v1). Borderline Fabless Design.

company_description: French semiconductor startup building optical interposer technology using nanolasers for chiplet-to-chiplet interconnect. Targets the AI/HPC packaging bottleneck addressed by Ayar Labs and Lightmatter.
lead_investors: Elaia, Earlybird Venture Capital, OVNI Capital
robotnik_take: Optical interposer using nanolasers for chiplet-to-chiplet interconnect. Targets the same packaging-bottleneck thesis as Ayar Labs / Lightmatter.

company_description: Designs AirJet, a solid-state active-cooling chip for laptops, smartphones, and increasingly servers. Replaces conventional fans with a silent piezoelectric cooler; relevant to thermal-envelope constraints on AI GPUs and high-power SoCs.
co_investors: Prosperity7 Ventures, Mayfield Fund, Clear Ventures, Addition, Qualcomm Ventures, MVP Ventures, StepStone Group, Alumni Ventures
robotnik_take: AirJet solid-state piezoelectric MEMS active cooling on-package for AI chips. Borderline category — could fit Machine Vision & Sensors as MEMS device.

company_description: Builds chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) equipment for silicon carbide wafers, MEMS, advanced packaging, and TSV/3D integration processes.
robotnik_take: Chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) equipment for SiC, MEMS, packaging, TSV/3D integration. Capital + revolving line of credit.

company_description: Canadian developer of monolithic silicon photonic interconnects for AI, machine learning, and high-performance computing. Backed by Canadian government investment in compute-interconnect supply chains.
lead_investors: FedDev Ontario (Government of Canada repayable investment)
robotnik_take: Monolithic silicon photonic interconnects for AI/ML and HPC. Repayable government investment — co-packaged optics race continues with sovereign funding.

company_description: German developer of graphene-based photonic chips for AI and high-bandwidth interconnect applications. Building a pilot graphene photonic chip line in Aachen; Porsche and Scania are strategic investors.
co_investors: Scania Growth, Capnamic Ventures, Tech Vision Fonds, NRW.BANK, Vsquared Ventures, Cambium Capital, Onsight Ventures
robotnik_take: Equity portion of combined Eur254.4M Series A: Eur25.7M private equity (Porsche/Scania-led) for graphene photonic chip pilot line in Aachen. Companion IPCEI government tranche tracked as separate row.

company_description: German developer of graphene-based photonic chips for AI and high-bandwidth interconnect applications. Building a pilot graphene photonic chip line in Aachen; Porsche and Scania are strategic investors.
lead_investors: German federal government & North Rhine-Westphalia (IPCEI ME/CT)
robotnik_take: Government portion of combined Eur254.4M Series A: Eur228.7M IPCEI public funding under Important Project of Common European Interest. Companion private equity tranche tracked as separate row.

company_description: UK Cambridge-based developer of computational photonics design tools, process design kits (PDKs), and prototyping packaging for integrated photonics designers.
