co_investors: Accenture Ventures, Banco Santander InnoEnergy Climate Tech Fund, Claret Capital Partners, Taavet Hinrikus, Kheng Nam Lee
robotnik_take: UK satellite startup providing end-to-end smallsat missions and OpenConstellation virtual sharing platform. Capital lifts company beyond cubesats into larger spacecraft and constellations. Compares with Planet/Spire as integrator-operator EO play.

company_description: Builds in-space transportation vehicles — the Mira orbital tug for last-mile satellite delivery and Helios kick stage for direct-to-GEO transfers. Founded by former SpaceX propulsion lead Tom Mueller; targets commercial and national security in-space mobility.
co_investors: Founders Fund, Lux Capital, Airbus Ventures, Space Capital
robotnik_take: Tom Mueller's (ex-SpaceX) in-space mobility startup. Series A funds Helios kick stage (direct-to-GEO) and Mira tug. Strong strategic backer (RTX) signals defense / national security pull-through. Compares with Momentus / D-Orbit but with better engineering pedigree.

company_description: German thermal-infrared earth observation startup operating satellites that measure land-surface temperature for agriculture, water-stress monitoring, and infrastructure. Selected as a contractor on the EU Copernicus thermal-imaging mission.
co_investors: Einstein Industries Ventures, FTTF, Lakestar, Vsquared Ventures, Amathaon Capital, Natural Ventures, OHB Ventures, EIT Food
robotnik_take: German thermal-IR EO data startup; Copernicus thermal-imaging contract winner. Seed extension brings total to ~$32M. Thermal infrared is a less-crowded wedge than optical/SAR - comparable to SatVu (UK) but more advanced commercial trajectory.

company_description: Multi-orbit satellite operator formed by the 2023 merger of GEO operator Eutelsat and LEO operator OneWeb. Targets multi-orbit broadband and connectivity services as a European Starlink challenger.
co_investors: Eutelsat shareholders / OneWeb (Bharti, UK Government, SoftBank, Hanwha)
robotnik_take: Major satellite-comms M&A: Eutelsat (GEO) + OneWeb (LEO) combine into multi-orbit group valued at $3.4B at deal close. Key Starlink challenger structure for Europe. Closed via Eutelsat shareholder vote 28 Sep 2023; OneWeb retains UK ops as Eutelsat OneWeb. Targeting EUR 2B 2027 revenue.

company_description: Chinese reusable launch startup — the first private Chinese company to reach orbit with a liquid-propellant rocket (Tianlong-2, April 2023). Developing the Tianlong-3 Falcon 9-class reusable rocket.
robotnik_take: Chinese reusable-launch startup, first private Chinese co. to reach orbit with a liquid rocket (Tianlong-2, Apr 2023). C-round 'hundreds of millions of yuan' brings cumulative raised to ~$414M; funding for Tianlong-3 (SpaceX Falcon 9 analog). Stage_uncertain reflects translation ambiguity around C/C+. Tracxn-only specifics; primary source SpaceNews.

company_description: Italian ground-segment-as-a-service operator supporting around 80 satellites with more than 10,000 satellite passes per month across its global ground-station network. Competes with Atlas Space Operations and Viasat Real-Time Earth.
lead_investors: CDP Venture Capital SGR, Neva SGR
co_investors: RedSeed Ventures, Primo Space, Whysol Investments; plus EUR 15M EIB venture debt
robotnik_take: Italian ground-segment-as-a-service operator. EUR 20M Series B equity (~$22M) plus EUR 15M EIB venture debt funds expansion of its global ground-station network supporting ~80 satellites; 10,000+ satellite passes per month. Pure-play ground systems play comparable with Leaf vs Atlas Space / Viasat RTE.

company_description: Operates a global commercial telescope network and provides space domain awareness and satellite-tracking products to the US Space Force and commercial constellation operators.
robotnik_take: Slingshot draws on Trinity Capital venture-debt facility. Slingshot is a leading commercial space domain awareness / satellite tracking platform with a global telescope network used by Space Force and commercial operators. Debt complements 2022 $40.85M Series A-2.

company_description: German small-launch developer building the RFA ONE launcher, with a planned first orbital flight from SaxaVord Spaceport. Majority owned by OHB; demonstrated a first-of-kind European upper-stage hot fire test.
co_investors: OHB SE (existing majority strategic investor)
robotnik_take: EUR 30M (~$33M) convertible bond from KKR following RFA's first-of-kind European upper-stage hot fire test in May 2023. Capital advances RFA ONE small launcher toward first orbital flight from SaxaVord. KKR's first space deal; OHB remains majority owner. Pairs with separate EUR 11M DLR grant in 2023.

company_description: Building the BlueBird LEO constellation that delivers broadband cellular service directly to standard unmodified smartphones, partnering with mobile network operators for spectrum. Public on NASDAQ (ASTS).
co_investors: Equipment-backed lender (undisclosed) for $15M tranche
robotnik_take: Comprehensive financing package with up to $100M Senior Secured Credit Facility from Atlas Credit Partners (~$50M funded at closing) plus $15M Equipment-Backed Loan. Together with prior $57M June equity offering and $7M Q2 ATM, total Q2-Q3 raise hit ~$179M. Funds first five BlueBird commercial satellites for direct-to-cell broadband. Public company (NASDAQ: ASTS).

company_description: Indian earth-observation and AI analytics platform serving agriculture and financial institution credit risk assessment. Developing four high-resolution optical and multispectral satellites for its own constellation.
lead_investors: Baring Private Equity Partners India, Promus Ventures
co_investors: Omidyar Network India, xto10X, Force Ventures, Luckbox Ventures, IndigoEdge Advisors
robotnik_take: Indian EO + AI platform serving agriculture / financial-institution credit risk. Series A funds four high-resolution optical/multispectral satellites planned for Q4 2025 plus Americas/APAC expansion. Closely tied to India's Chandrayaan-3 lunar success driving investor interest in India space stack.

company_description: Develops TrueTwin, a cloud platform that digitally simulates and operates satellites end-to-end — effectively a 'satellite OS' product. Lockheed Martin Ventures is a strategic investor.
co_investors: HCVC, E2MC, Acequia Capital, Possible Ventures, Lockheed Martin Ventures, Ananth Technologies, Antaris founders
robotnik_take: Preferred seed extension brings cumulative seed-stage raise to nearly $10M. Antaris's TrueTwin cloud platform digitally simulates and operates satellites end-to-end - a 'satellite OS' wedge. Lockheed Martin Ventures participation signals defense pull-through. Compares with Loft Federal/Quindar.

company_description: Builds an autonomous space traffic coordination and collision-avoidance platform for satellite operators and the US Space Force. The Pathfinder product provides automated conjunction screening and maneuver recommendations.
robotnik_take: Autonomous space traffic coordination / collision avoidance platform; brings cumulative VC raise to $10.7M. Boulder-area startup serving commercial satellite operators and Space Force. Pathfinder 3.0 product launch alongside funding. Comparable to LeoLabs / Privateer in space situational awareness niche.

company_description: Launch company that pivoted from small launch vehicles to spacecraft engines in 2023. Previously public on NASDAQ (ASTR) before defaulting on senior secured notes in late 2023 and going private in mid-2024.
lead_investors: High Trail Investments ON LLC (institutional investor)
robotnik_take: Senior Secured Notes financing of $12.5M aggregate principal amount; ~$10.8M net proceeds. 9.0% notes due Nov 2024, secured by all Astra assets. Coincides with August 2023 25% workforce reduction and pivot from launch to spacecraft engines. Astra later defaulted on these notes in November 2023 (eventually went private in mid-2024). Public co at time (Nasdaq: ASTR).

company: Orienspace (Dongfang Space / Yantai Dongfang Space Technology)
company_description: Chinese commercial launch company developing the Gravity-1 medium-lift solid rocket and the Gravity-2 medium-lift liquid launch vehicle. Competes with Space Pioneer, iSpace, and Galactic Energy.
robotnik_take: Chinese launch startup raised 'hundreds of millions of yuan' (~$27-124M range) in B+ round. Funds Gravity-2 medium-lift liquid launch vehicle development and mass production. Cumulative ~$150M raised across rounds. Subsequent ~$84M reported January 2024. Stage uncertain due to translation ambiguity around B/B+. Compares with Space Pioneer / iSpace as Chinese commercial launch entrant.

company_description: Vertically integrated lithium-ion battery cell manufacturer for European automotive and grid storage markets. Operated gigafactories in Sweden and Germany; held battery recycling capacity through subsidiaries Revolt and lithium-metal IP through Cuberg before filing for bankruptcy in November 2024.
co_investors: Investment Management Corporation of Ontario (IMCO), Canada Pension Plan Investment Board, OMERS
robotnik_take: Convertible note extension funds gigafactory ramp; Northvolt is Europe's flagship vertically-integrated battery champion. Total equity+debt now over $9B against $55B in offtake commitments. Compares to Western pure-plays like CATL but with Western governance.

company_description: Recycles end-of-life lithium-ion batteries and manufactures battery materials, including anode copper foil and cathode active materials, from the recovered metals. Operating plants in Nevada and South Carolina supply both EV battery makers and grid storage customers, positioned as a domestic alternative to Chinese cathode/anode supply chains.
lead_investors: Goldman Sachs Asset Management, Capricorn's Technology Impact Fund, T. Rowe Price
co_investors: OMERS, Microsoft Climate Innovation Fund, Deepwater Asset Management
robotnik_take: JB Straubel's vertically-integrated battery recycler hits $5B post; total equity at $2B. Building anode copper foil and cathode active materials in Nevada/South Carolina. The closest US analog to a domestic ALB+LAC play through circular economy.

company_description: Recycles lithium-ion batteries and produces cathode active materials (CAM) and precursor (pCAM) using its Hydro-to-Cathode process, which synthesizes new cathode directly from recovered black mass. Operates plants in Massachusetts, Georgia, and Kentucky as a domestic alternative to Chinese cathode supply.
lead_investors: Decarbonization Partners, Temasek, Qatar Investment Authority
co_investors: Tenaska, Alliance Resource Partners, PULSE - CMA CGM Energy Fund, BHP Ventures, Fifth Wall, Hitachi Ventures, Mirae Asset, At One Ventures, Agave Partners, Alumni Ventures
robotnik_take: $460M Series D + $82M earlier 2023 equity. Hydro-to-Cathode direct precursor synthesis for pCAM/CAM from recycled black mass. Complements $480M DoE grants for Hopkinsville, KY plant. Domestic alternative to Chinese cathode supply.

company_description: Builds the Dunkirk lithium-ion battery gigafactory in northern France, with Renault as anchor offtake customer for high-performance NMC cells. Positioned alongside Northvolt and ACC in the European battery sovereignty effort.
co_investors: Renault Group, EQT Ventures, EIT InnoEnergy, Sibanye-Stillwater, Credit Agricole Assurances, Pulse, Arkema
robotnik_take: Series C of €850M ($916M) plus €600M EIB debt and €650M French subsidies = €2.1B total package for Dunkirk gigafactory. Renault offtake is anchor demand. Europe's bid for battery sovereignty alongside Northvolt and ACC.

company_description: Develops lithium-sulfur EV battery cells using its 3D Graphene supermaterial platform. Cobalt- and nickel-free chemistry positioned as an alternative to Asian NMC and LFP cell incumbents; Stellantis is a strategic investor and offtake partner.
co_investors: Stellantis, FedEx, Honeywell, Walbridge Aldinger Company
robotnik_take: Lithium-sulfur cells using 3D graphene from methane; cobalt/nickel/manganese/graphite-free. Total equity now >$410M. Strategic Stellantis tie-in signals OEM appetite for non-China supply chain even at lower energy density.

company_description: Develops AI-accelerated LFP and LMFP cathode chemistries for lithium-ion batteries. Operates an 'atoms-to-tons' platform combining computational chemistry with a pilot plant; GM is a strategic investor and offtake partner.
co_investors: Social Capital, Fontinalis Partners, Earthshot Ventures, The Keffi Group, Boutique Venture Partners, GS Futures, Bricks Capital Management, Zeon Ventures, Scribble VC, WovenEarth Ventures, Bonds Investment Group
robotnik_take: AI-driven LFP/LMFP cathode developer. GM strategic anchor signals serious OEM commitment to non-China cathode chemistry development. $40M first close of $60M target. Atoms-to-tons platform for cell-design iteration. Compares to Mitra's role as a Western alternative to Chinese cathode majors like Yuneng/Dynanonic.

company_description: Builds green steel using hydrogen-based direct reduced iron (H-DRI) instead of coal-fired blast furnaces. Targets 95% emissions reduction with a planned 2.5 Mt/year output from a new plant in Boden, Sweden. Renamed Stegra after the initial H2 Green Steel build phase.
co_investors: Andra AP-fonden, Temasek, AMF, Cristina Stenbeck, Hitachi Energy, IMAS Foundation, Kinnevik, Schaeffler, Vargas, Wallenberg Investments (FAM)
robotnik_take: Largest European private placement of 2023. Hydrogen-DRI green steel for the Boden, Sweden plant. Targets 95% emissions reduction vs blast furnace; 2.5Mt/yr production by 2026. The European answer to Boston Metal's MOE approach, validated by sovereign-tier capital.

company_description: Commercializes molten oxide electrolysis (MOE) for producing primary steel and high-value metals directly by electrochemistry, eliminating blast furnace coal consumption. MIT spinout; ships high-value metals as first revenue product, with full MOE green steel targeted for later commercialization.
co_investors: Microsoft Climate Innovation Fund, SiteGround Capital, IFC (World Bank), Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BHP Ventures, Prelude Ventures, M&G Investments, Goehring & Rozencwajg, Baillie Gifford
robotnik_take: Final close of Series C ($120M earlier + $140M Sept). Molten oxide electrolysis (MOE) for green steel — MIT spinout commercializing direct-electrolyte primary steel production. High-value metals first revenue 2024; full MOE steel by 2026. Aramco joining is meaningful for Saudi Vision 2030 industrial linkage.

company_description: Manufactures LFP cells and stationary battery energy storage systems (BESS) for grid-scale applications. Shipped 5 GWh in 2022; expanding through subsidiaries in Munich and the US. State-backed Chinese player competing with Form Energy, ESS, and Eos on the export side.
lead_investors: Beijing Financial Street Capital Operation Group (BFS Capital), China Life Private Equity Investment
co_investors: BOC Financial Asset Investment, Goldstone Investment, CS Capital, China Venture Capital Fund (CVC), CICC Capital, CDH Investments, BOC Asset Management, Dinghui Baifu, CMG-SDIC Capital, China-US Green Fund, Matrix Partners China, Hefei Industry Investment Holding Group, CDI New Energy
robotnik_take: RMB 4.5B (~$622M) Series C ahead of expected IPO. LFP-focused stationary BESS player; delivered 5GWh in 2022. Expanding into European (Munich subsidiary) and US markets. State-tied capital stack underscores Chinese BESS dominance vs western pure-plays like Form, ESS, Eos.

company_description: Uses engineered protein molecular assemblers to extract lithium and other critical metals from low-concentration brines, including oilfield wastewater. Targets capped wells in Oklahoma, Arkansas, and Texas as a biology-based DLE approach.
co_investors: Helena, Goldcrest Capital, Tapestry VC, Civilization Ventures, Plug and Play, Climate Capital, Yamaha Motor Ventures, BoxGroup, Sam Altman (angel)
robotnik_take: Engineered-protein molecular assemblers extracting lithium and other critical metals from low-concentration brines. Targets oilfield wastewater and capped wells in OK/AR/TX — claims 30x domestic lithium production potential vs evaporative South American methods. Adjacent to Lilac, EnergyX in DLE category but biology-based vs ion-exchange.

company_description: German developer of modular battery energy storage systems (BESS) using second-life EV batteries. Multi-level inverter topology removes the weakest-cell limitation that has historically hampered second-life applications.
co_investors: European Innovation Council, UVC Partners, Bayern Kapital, BMW i Ventures, BayBG
robotnik_take: €15M (~$16.5M) round to scale modular BESS using second-life EV batteries. Multi-level inverter topology removes weakest-cell limitation that has hampered second-life applications. Sits at intersection of battery materials/recycling and grid storage — capital-light vs Hithium/Northvolt new-cell scale plays.

company_description: Builds refractory-brick thermal energy storage — heat batteries charged by renewable electricity that discharge process heat up to 1,500 degC for industrial customers. First commercial unit operating at the Calgren biofuels plant.
lead_investors: Microsoft Climate Innovation Fund, Aramco Ventures, Rio Tinto, SABIC
co_investors: Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Energy Impact Partners, SCG, TITAN, SDCL Energy Efficiency Income Trust (SEEIT), John Doerr
robotnik_take: Refractory-brick thermal energy storage (heat battery) charged by renewables, discharging up to 1500°C industrial heat. First commercial unit live at Calgren biofuel plant. Strategic stack of cement (TITAN, SCG), petrochem (SABIC, Aramco), and mining (Rio Tinto) signals demand for industrial decarbonization. Adjacent to Antora and Kraftblock in TES category.

company_description: German thermal energy storage company building heat batteries from recycled steel-slag composite that store up to 1,300 degC for multi-week duration. ArcelorMittal-linked Finindus and Techint are strategic investors.
co_investors: Finindus, A&G Energy Transition Tech Fund, TechEnergy Ventures (Techint), Future Industry Ventures
robotnik_take: €20M (~$22M) Series B for thermal storage built from recycled steel-slag composite. Stores up to 1300°C, multi-week duration. ArcelorMittal-linked Finindus and Techint involvement signals heavy-industry pull for high-temp electrification. Direct peer to Rondo, Antora; differentiated by use of waste-stream feedstock.

company_description: Modular zero-knowledge blockchain ecosystem operating Manta Pacific (an Ethereum L2 for ZK applications). Native MANTA token launched in January 2024; targets the ZK proving market.
co_investors: Alliance, CoinFund, SevenX Ventures, EigenTrust, Hashed
robotnik_take: Modular zero-knowledge ecosystem; round funded launch of Manta Pacific L2 testnet for ZK applications and Asia expansion. Token (MANTA) launched Jan 2024. ZK as a primitive sits adjacent to AI/data privacy compute infra rather than physical DePIN, but tagged DePIN-adjacent given hardware ZK proving market emergence.

company_description: Builds general-purpose humanoid robots for commercial and industrial work. Develops both the hardware platform and AI models in-house, with a collaboration agreement with OpenAI for frontier model integration.
co_investors: Aliya Capital, Bold Ventures, Tamarack Global, FJ Labs, Till Reuter
robotnik_take: Brett Adcock's general-purpose humanoid play closes Series A on top of $100M founder seed. Early bet on Figure 01 humanoid; early-mover positioning before sector heated up in 2024. NVDA-led Apptronik comp came later at $5B+.

company_description: Built the Covariant Brain, a foundation model for warehouse-picking robotic arms. Co-founded by Pieter Abbeel; reverse-acquihired by Amazon in 2024, with much of the team and IP joining Amazon's robotics organization.
co_investors: Canada Pension Plan Investment Board, Amplify Partners, Gates Frontier Holdings, AIX Ventures, Northgate Capital
robotnik_take: Covariant Brain warehouse-picking foundation model; total raised $222M. Pieter Abbeel's foundation-model thesis preceded the 2024 reverse-acquihire by Amazon — pre-AGI infrastructure for robotics manipulation.

company_description: Operates an autonomous drone delivery network for medical supplies, retail goods, and food. Started with blood and vaccine delivery in Rwanda and Ghana; now expanding US operations to Houston, Phoenix, and Seattle. Builds both the fixed-wing delivery drones and the operating software stack.
robotnik_take: Largest robotics round of April 2023 — $4.2B post-money makes Zipline the highest-valued US drone co at the time. P2 tethered-droid system rollout for medical/logistics drives valuation; eVTOL comps include NYSE:JOBY.

company_description: Builds Dexter, a smaller, mobile surgical robot for ambulatory surgery centers, designed to compete with Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci on cost and footprint. FDA-cleared for gallbladder removal, hysterectomy, and hernia repair.
robotnik_take: Dexter robot targets ASC market — direct shot at Intuitive Surgical (NASDAQ:ISRG)'s da Vinci dominance with smaller, mobile platform. FDA-cleared for gallbladder, hysterectomy, and hernia repair.

company_description: Builds the LaserWeeder, an autonomous farm implement that uses computer vision and high-powered lasers to kill weeds in row crops without herbicides. Sells to specialty-crop growers; claims significant cost reduction versus chemical weed control.
co_investors: Anthos Capital, Fuse Venture Capital, Ignition Partners, Liquid2, Voyager Capital
robotnik_take: LaserWeeder uses computer vision and lasers for chemical-free weed control — labor-shortage thesis applied to row crops. 80% reduction in weed-control costs vs. Herbicide.

company_description: Builds the Carter cargo cart and Grace fleet-orchestration software for warehouses. Founded by Rodney Brooks (co-founder of iRobot and Rethink Robotics); competes with Locus Robotics and Symbotic in the warehouse AMR segment.
co_investors: Future Ventures, Energy Impact Partners, JAZZ Ventures, Playground Global
robotnik_take: Rodney Brooks' (iRobot/Rethink) third act — Carter cart + Grace software for warehouses. RaaS model competes directly with Locus and Symbotic (NASDAQ:SYM) ecosystem.

company_description: Built FreeMove, a 3D safeguarding system that turns industrial robots into collaborative robots through machine-vision safety perception. Acquired by Symbotic (NASDAQ: SYM) in 2024.
co_investors: Safar Partners, Yamaha Motor Ventures
robotnik_take: FreeMove 3D safeguarding turns industrial robots into cobots — Amazon's strategic check signals automation roadmap. Veo subsequently acquired by Symbotic (NASDAQ:SYM) in 2024.

company_description: Built remote-driving teleoperation software for forklifts and yard trucks after pivoting from passenger AVs. Shut down operations in March 2024; certain assets (Voysys) were acquired by Serve Robotics.
robotnik_take: Remote-driving teleop for forklifts and yard trucks — pivot from passenger AVs proved insufficient and company shut down March 2024. Foreshadowed teleop consolidation; Voysys later acquired by Serve Robotics (NASDAQ:SERV).

company_description: Software-defined-vehicle and autonomous driving software arm of the Hyundai Motor Group. Builds the unified software stack and autonomous mobility platform across Hyundai and Kia vehicles.
robotnik_take: Hyundai/Kia inject KRW 1.05T to entrench 42dot as their global software center for autonomous mobility. Effectively a captive subsidiary cap raise — comparable to GM/Cruise dynamic, but with higher integration to OEM software stack.

company_description: Israeli developer of GPS anti-jamming systems for UAVs operating in contested electromagnetic environments. Hanwha is a strategic investor anchoring Korean defense customer access.
co_investors: Honeywell Ventures, Next Gear Ventures
robotnik_take: GPS anti-jamming for UAVs in contested EM environments. Defense procurement tailwind from US/Israeli/Korean armed forces; Hanwha lead aligns with Korean defense build-out.

company_description: Allen Institute (AI2) spinout building a copilot and data platform for robotics engineers — enabling natural-language search and debugging of petabyte-scale robot sensor data.
co_investors: Allen Institute for AI (AI2), FUSE Ventures
robotnik_take: AI2 spinout building a copilot/data platform for robotics engineers — search/debug petabyte-scale sensor data via natural language. Picks-and-shovels for the robotics foundation-model wave.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of autonomous mobile robots and unmanned forklifts for warehouse logistics. Competes with Geek+ and Quicktron in the Chinese domestic AMR market.
co_investors: China Merchants Venture Capital
robotnik_take: AMR + unmanned forklift combo for warehouse logistics; fifth-gen multi-modal flexible AMR launched late 2023. Part of China's intense domestic AMR competition vs. Geek+, Quicktron.

company_description: Hefei-based Chinese manufacturer of autonomous mobile robots and outdoor unmanned forklifts for industrial logistics applications.
robotnik_take: Hefei-based AMR/unmanned forklift OEM, launched 4th-gen outdoor unmanned forklift in 2023. Amount undisclosed; estimated meaningful given investor stage.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of telepresence robots for business and healthcare remote-presence applications.
robotnik_take: Telepresence robots for business/healthcare. Round size undisclosed. Service-robot segment competing with Bear Robotics, Pudu.

company_description: Builds a modular outdoor yard care robot with interchangeable mowing, snow-blowing, and leaf-blowing attachments. Sells direct to consumers with strong Kickstarter origins; targets cold-climate North American homeowners.
robotnik_take: Modular outdoor yard care robot (mowing, snow blowing, leaf blowing). Highest-funded consumer robotics Kickstarter ($3.45M, 2022); now scaling DTC consumer hardware.

company_description: Korean developer of wearable exoskeletons including the WIBS industrial back-support and the WIM mobility-assist products. Founded by former Samsung robotics engineers.
robotnik_take: WIM wearable exoskeleton for walking-mobility assistance, targeting aging populations. Sold 600 units in first 6 months in Korea before US/CES 2025 push.

company_description: Korean manufacturer of articulated, orthogonal (gantry), and SCARA industrial robots. Pivoting toward logistics automation; pursuing a KOSDAQ IPO.
co_investors: Devsisters Ventures, Hana Securities
robotnik_take: Articulated, orthogonal, and SCARA industrial robots; pivot toward logistics automation. First VC round since 2021 credit guarantee fund — KOSDAQ IPO planned.

company_description: Spanish manufacturer of the Keyper quadruped robot for industrial inspection. Acquired by Helsing in January 2026 as part of defense robotics build-out; competes with Boston Dynamics Spot in EU industrial verticals.
robotnik_take: Quadruped Keyper robot for industrial inspection — Boston Dynamics Spot competitor in EU industrial verticals. Acquired by Helsing in Jan 2026 as part of defense robotics build-out.

company_description: Chinese construction robotics company addressing labor-shortage automation in the Chinese construction sector.
robotnik_take: Construction robotics — labor-shortage automation for Chinese construction sector.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of servo drives, servo motors, and motion control products for industrial automation. Domestic-substitute play against Yaskawa and Mitsubishi.
co_investors: Feitu Venture Capital
robotnik_take: Servo drives, servo motors, and motion control for industrial automation. Domestic substitute play vs. Yaskawa, Mitsubishi.

company_description: ETH Zurich spinout building the ANYmal quadruped robot, including the explosion-proof ANYmal X. Customers include oil and gas operators (Petronas, Shell, SLB) and chemical producers using the robot for autonomous inspection.
co_investors: Bessemer Venture Partners, Aramco Ventures, Swisscom Ventures, Swisscanto Private Equity
robotnik_take: ETH spinout building ANYmal X explosion-proof quadruped — over $150M in pre-orders from Petronas, Shell, SLB, BASF. Direct competitor to Boston Dynamics Spot in oil/gas inspection.

company_description: French developer of the Maestro laparoscopic surgical assistant, a cart-based robot designed to assist with camera and instrument holding during minimally invasive surgery. Fred Moll chairs the board; NVIDIA is an investor.
co_investors: Johnson & Johnson Innovation, Sofinnova MD Start, GT Healthcare Capital, Cathay Health
robotnik_take: Maestro laparoscopic surgical assistant; Fred Moll (Intuitive Surgical co-founder) as Board Chair signals strategic positioning vs. ISRG. NVIDIA participation underscores AI/robotics convergence in surgical robotics.

company_description: Builds the ARA precision-spraying tractor implement, which uses plant-by-plant computer vision to spot-spray herbicides, pesticides, and fertilizers, claiming 70-95% reduction in agrochemical use. Sells to specialty-crop growers.
co_investors: Swisscanto Invest, Yara Growth Ventures, Flexstone Partners
robotnik_take: ARA precision spraying reduces herbicide/pesticide/fertilizer use 70-95% via plant-by-plant computer vision. AgTech robotics adjacent to Carbon Robotics' laser-weeding play.

company_description: Israeli developer of long-wave infrared (LWIR) thermal cameras for ADAS pedestrian-safety applications and industrial monitoring. Gentex is a strategic investor anchoring automotive OEM distribution.
robotnik_take: LWIR thermal sensors for ADAS pedestrian-safety applications; Gentex strategic anchor brings auto-OEM channel. Comp to NASDAQ:LAZR / NASDAQ:OUST in sensing stack but thermal niche.

company_description: Israeli developer of the Foretify safety verification and validation platform for ADAS and autonomous vehicle software. Customers include Volvo and Daimler Truck/Torc; NVIDIA and Toyota are strategic investors.
co_investors: Woven Capital, NVIDIA, Artofin VC, MoreTech, Nationwide, Volvo Group VC, Jump Capital
robotnik_take: Foretify safety verification/validation platform for ADAS/AV — Volvo, Daimler/Torc as reference customers. NVIDIA + Toyota validates AV simulation infrastructure thesis. Series C topped up to $85M by Dec 2023.

company_description: Builds space robotics for satellite servicing and lunar surface operations — robotic arms and rovers for in-orbit assembly and lunar exploration. Japanese-founded with US operations expanding for lunar demonstrations.
robotnik_take: Lunar rover and inchworm robotic arm for in-space servicing/construction — TRL push and US engineering-model facility expansion. Comp to Astrobotic, Intuitive Machines (NASDAQ:LUNR) in space robotics.

company_description: Builds AI-powered sorting robots for municipal solid waste recycling and also operates AMP ONE, its own end-to-end automated sortation facilities. Shifting from selling hardware to operating waste-sortation infrastructure.
co_investors: Congruent Ventures, Wellington Management
robotnik_take: AI-powered recycling sortation; Microsoft Climate fund participation aligns with circular-economy thesis. Total Series C reaches >$99M; bigger 2024 round followed.

company_description: German manufacturer of the Wingcopter 198 eVTOL delivery drone for medical, grocery, and parcel last-mile delivery. Partnerships and customers include REWE Group and ITOCHU.
robotnik_take: Quasi-equity venture loan from EIB to scale Wingcopter 198 eVTOL delivery drone for medical/groceries. Total raised >€100M across REWE, ITOCHU, Expa.

company_description: Builds the Vesper nano-drone for the US Army's Soldier Borne Sensor program. Targets the defense small-UAS segment alongside Skydio and AeroVironment.
robotnik_take: Nano-drone for US Army Soldier Borne Sensor program; defense procurement tailwind alongside Skydio (priv) and AeroVironment (NASDAQ:AVAV).

company_description: Builds the Vector reconnaissance UAS — a fixed-wing vertical-takeoff drone for tactical intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance. Sells to European militaries including the German Bundeswehr; active in Ukraine in combat use.
robotnik_take: Vector reconnaissance VTOL drones for German Armed Forces, partnership with Airbus Defence. Bridge into bigger €63.6M Series B in October 2023; defense-tech tailwind from Ukraine demand.

company_description: Builds Robotics-as-a-Service truck-loading systems that reduce 30-60 minute trailer loads to about 5 minutes. Customers include John Deere, GE Appliances, Valeo, and Nissan; deployable without facility modification.
robotnik_take: SlipBot 5-min truck loading/unloading RaaS for trailer docks; commercial launch 2023. Direct competitor to Pickle Robot, Boston Dynamics Stretch in dock automation.

company_description: Norwegian developer of Genius autonomous robotic wheels — modular drive wheels that convert conventional carts and equipment into autonomous mobile robots without redesign. Targets warehouse retrofit deployments.
robotnik_take: Genius autonomous robotic wheels — converts conventional carts/equipment into AMRs without redesign. Picks-and-shovels for warehouse retrofits.

company_description: Chinese supplier of auto-parking, ADAS, and regional autonomous driving software, deployed in hundreds of thousands of vehicles for Volkswagen, Toyota, Lexus, Chery, and Great Wall.
robotnik_take: Auto-parking, ADAS, regional autonomy software embedded in hundreds of thousands of vehicles for VW, Toyota, Lexus, Chery, Great Wall. Series B1 financing ahead of overseas expansion.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of the Yarbo modular yard robot, with interchangeable snow-blower and lawnmower attachments. Targets cold-climate North American consumers as a competitor to Husqvarna and Worx.
robotnik_take: $20M Series A funds Yarbo's North American distribution scale-up for the modular yard-robot stack (interchangeable snow-blower + lawnmower attachments). Comp set: Husqvarna (HUSQ-B SS) on outdoor power, Worx (Positec private) on consumer robotics. The bet is whether a single robotic chassis with seasonal swap-in attachments beats single-purpose autonomous mowers (Husqvarna Automower, Mammotion) on year-round utilization.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of servo drives, servo motors, industrial controllers, HMIs, and linear motors. Targets the domestic motion-control market against Yaskawa, Mitsubishi, and Delta.
robotnik_take: Servo drives, servo motors, industrial controllers, HMIs, linear motors. Domestic substitute play vs. Yaskawa, Mitsubishi, Delta in China motion control.

company_description: Canadian SFU spinout building the XoMotion exoskeleton, which enables independent walking for mobility-impaired users. Holds Health Canada approval; competes with Ekso Bionics in the powered exoskeleton segment.
robotnik_take: XoMotion exoskeleton enables independent walking for mobility-impaired users — SFU spinout; Health Canada approval Sept 2024. Competitor to Ekso Bionics (NASDAQ:EKSO).

company_description: Turkish manufacturer of indoor delivery robots for warehouse applications. Targets the emerging-market last-mile and intralogistics robot segment.
robotnik_take: Indoor delivery robots for Turkish warehouses; emerging-market last-mile play.

company_description: Canadian humanoid robot company building Phoenix, a general-purpose humanoid for industrial and enterprise work. Accenture is a strategic investor anchoring enterprise integration; known for advanced dexterous-hand work.
robotnik_take: Phoenix gen-6 humanoid + Carbon AI control system. Strategic Innovation Fund grant supports general-purpose humanoid R&D — direct comp to Figure (priv), Apptronik (priv).

company_description: German developer of driver-assistance software and cloud analytics for construction machinery. Customers include Sennebogen, MTS, and Kiesel.
robotnik_take: Construction-machine driver-assistance software and cloud analytics — digitalization of construction equipment. Customers include Sennebogen, MTS, Kiesel.

company_description: Builds human-assisted autonomy software for yard trucking at ports, factories, and intermodal terminals. Partnerships with Volkswagen, DB Schenker, and HHLA anchor commercial deployments in industrial logistics.
co_investors: Fly Ventures, Speedinvest, Push Ventures, HHLA Next, DB Schenker (Schenker Ventures), Krone
robotnik_take: Teleoperated electric yard trucks for ports/terminals — human-in-the-loop teleop addresses 400K-2M EU truck-driver shortage. Comp to Outrider (priv), Plus.ai in yard automation.

company_description: Chinese commercial UAV manufacturer backed by the Heilongjiang government to anchor a regional UAV manufacturing base. Targets state procurement for unmanned systems alongside DJI in the broader Chinese commercial drone market.
co_investors: SenGong Investments, Keli Investments, Harbin Venture Capital Group
robotnik_take: Heilongjiang government-led UAV investment to anchor China's largest UAV base; Chinese state procurement for unmanned systems is a key thematic. Domestic competitor to DJI in commercial UAV.

company_description: Israeli industrial drone-in-a-box company providing autonomous aerial inspection for utilities, refineries, and mines. Holds an FAA nationwide BVLOS waiver for autonomous industrial drone operations in the US.
co_investors: Zimmer Partners, U.S. Venture Partners, Delek US Holdings, Atento Capital, Spider Capital, Arkin Holdings
robotnik_take: Industrial drone-in-a-box for inspection at utilities, refineries, mines — combined $50M equity + $16M debt. FAA nationwide BVLOS waiver is sector-defining; comp to Skydio (priv) in industrial inspection.

company_description: Builds autonomous indoor inventory drones for warehouses with infrastructure-free deployment and automatic battery swap. Partnered with Kenco; competes with Verity and Gather AI in inventory drones.
co_investors: Ignite Innovation Fund, Krossroad Partners, SoftBank Ventures Asia
robotnik_take: Autonomous inventory drones with infrastructure-free, mapping-free deployment and auto battery-swap. Kenco partnership — direct comp to Verity, Gather AI in inventory drones.

company_description: Chinese vascular interventional surgical robotics company. Founder Guo Shuxiang previously led the Japan team that built the world's first neurointerventional surgical robot in 2008.
co_investors: Changan Private Capital, Changling Capital
robotnik_take: Vascular interventional surgical robot. Founder Guo Shuxiang led Japan team that built world's first neurointerventional surgical robot in 2008. Domestic Chinese surgical-robot competitor to Microport (HKG:0853).

company_description: Develops RapidPlan motion planning software for industrial robots — fast collision-free path planning for multi-robot work cells. Sells to automotive and industrial customers as software infrastructure for robotic arm deployments.
robotnik_take: RapidPlan motion planning for industrial robots; Boston-based extension brings total raised to $54M. Picks-and-shovels for robotic-arm motion control deployments.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of industrial robot bodies for welding, stamping, hardware grinding, 3C assembly, and material handling. Domestic competitor to KUKA, FANUC, and ABB in mid-tier articulated arms.
robotnik_take: Industrial robot bodies for welding, stamping, hardware grinding, 3C, handling. Domestic Chinese competitor to KUKA, Fanuc, ABB in mid-tier articulated arms.

company_description: Developed the SC1 autonomous eVTOL crop-spraying drone, the first commercially authorized electric VTOL aircraft in the US for agricultural spraying. Wound down in 2024 after failing to secure follow-on capital.
robotnik_take: SC1 autonomous eVTOL crop-spraying drone — first commercially authorized electric VTOL in US for ag spraying. Fully wound down 2024 after failing to secure follow-on.

company_description: India's leading unmanned aircraft systems manufacturer with about 50% of the domestic UAS market share. Public on Indian exchanges; primary supplier to the Indian Army and security forces.
robotnik_take: India's leading UAS manufacturer with 50% domestic share — IPO oversubscribed 106x at BSE/NSE. Defense procurement tailwind from India's indigenization push.

company_description: Builds an AI plus teleoperation hybrid system for trailer and container unloading. Competes with Pickle Robot in the truck-unloading robotics segment; backed by Korean strategic investors.
co_investors: Kakao Ventures, Bass Investment, Future Play, UT Austin Seed Fund
robotnik_take: AI + teleoperation hybrid for trailer/container unloading. Korean strategic LP set (Kakao, SV, Bass) — bridges teleop to autonomy. Direct competitor to Pickle Robot (priv).

company_description: Chinese developer of the SHURUI single-port endoscopic surgical robot with snake-like instruments. NMPA-approved in 2023; competes directly with Intuitive Surgical's SP platform.
robotnik_take: SHURUI single-port endoscopic surgical robot — China NMPA approval June 2023, world's first commercially available single-port system with snake-like instruments. Direct competitor to Intuitive Surgical (NASDAQ:ISRG) SP system.

company_description: Designs Rhea, an Arm Neoverse V1-based HPC microprocessor anchoring European supercomputing sovereignty under the France 2030 plan. State-backed; targets the European High-Performance Computing Joint Undertaking.
lead_investors: Arm, Atos Group (Eviden), French Tech Souveraineté
co_investors: European Innovation Council Fund, European Investment Bank
robotnik_take: Building Rhea HPC microprocessor based on Arm Neoverse V1 to anchor European supercomputing sovereignty. Targets Arm-based HPC niche similar to AMPR's Ampere Altra play but state-backed via France 2030 plan.

company_description: Develops silicon photonic compute and interconnect products for AI and HPC workloads. Main products are Envise (photonic compute), Passage (optical interconnect for chiplets and racks), and Idiom (software stack). Targets the AI scale-up problem that NVIDIA NVLink and Broadcom Tomahawk address electronically.
co_investors: Viking Global Investors, GV (Google Ventures), HPE Pathfinder
robotnik_take: Photonic compute platform delivering Envise, Passage, Idiom for AI/HPC workloads. Direct challenger to NVDA's interconnect dominance in dense AI clusters via silicon photonics; Fidelity participation suggests pre-IPO posture.

company_description: Develops the Photonic Fabric optical interconnect — silicon photonic chiplets that disaggregate memory from compute for AI clusters at higher bandwidth than electrical NVLink or Tomahawk-class switching. Targets hyperscalers building exascale AI systems.
lead_investors: IAG Capital Partners, Koch Disruptive Technologies, Temasek's Xora Innovation
co_investors: Samsung Catalyst, Smart Global Holdings, Porsche Automobil Holding SE, The Engine Fund, imec.xpand, M Ventures, Tyche Partners
robotnik_take: Photonic Fabric optical interconnect for disaggregated exascale compute. Claims 25x bandwidth advantage vs co-packaged optics, attacking NVDA NVLink/AVGO Tomahawk paradigm with photonic memory disaggregation.

company_description: Develops co-packaged optics (CPO) — silicon photonic chiplets integrated directly with compute and switch ASICs to replace copper interconnects in AI data centers. Strategic investors include AMD, NVIDIA, Intel, and MediaTek; manufactures at TSMC and GlobalFoundries.
co_investors: VentureTech Alliance, Boardman Bay Capital Management, IAG Capital Partners, NVIDIA, Tyche Partners
robotnik_take: In-package optical I/O for chip-to-chip connectivity. Up-round extends Series C to $155M total; NVDA participating signals strategic interest in optical interconnects to overcome HBM/copper power walls.

company_description: 12-inch middle-end-of-line foundry in Jiangyin, China specializing in advanced packaging services — wafer bumping, redistribution layer (RDL), and interposer fabrication. Positions as a domestic alternative to TSMC CoWoS and the OSAT majors ASE and Amkor.
lead_investors: Legend Capital, Goldstone Investment, INCE Capital
co_investors: Jade Stone Venture, Shang Qi Capital, Leafoison Capital, TCL Capital, China Fortune-Innovation Capital, GLP-C&D Capital, Oriza Rivertown, Oriza Hua Capital
robotnik_take: Pioneer 12-inch MEOL foundry with bumping/RDL capabilities for advanced packaging. China's answer to TSM CoWoS bottleneck and ASE/AMKR's OSAT dominance amid US export controls.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of high-end IC packaging substrates, addressing the domestic gap in advanced packaging materials currently dominated by Japanese (Ibiden, Shinko) and Taiwanese (Unimicron) suppliers.
co_investors: SL Capital, Lanhor Capital, Teda Venture Capital, Summitview Capital, Gaorong Capital, Jiangbei New Area Development Fund, Xingrui Capital, KQ Capital
robotnik_take: Produces high-end IC packaging substrates, addressing China's strategic gap in advanced packaging materials currently dominated by Japanese (Ibiden, Shinko) and Taiwanese (Unimicron) suppliers.

company_description: Chinese designer of GPU chips and graphics cards for embedded, industrial control, PC, and server applications. Part of China's domestic GPU effort to substitute NVIDIA and AMD imports under US export controls.
co_investors: Yantai Finance Development Investment Group, Shandong Provincial Guidance Fund
robotnik_take: Designs GPU chips and cards for embedded, industrial control, PC, server applications. Part of China's domestic GPU push to substitute NVDA/AMD imports under tightening export controls.

company_description: Chinese designer of automotive power semiconductors including MOSFETs, IGBTs, GaN HEMTs, and SiC diodes. Targets EV charging and inverter applications competing with Infineon and STMicroelectronics.
robotnik_take: Power semiconductor designer making automotive MOSFETs, IGBTs, GaN HEMTs, SiC diodes. Targets EV charging/inverters where INFY and STM dominate globally.

company_description: Vertically integrated silicon carbide (SiC) manufacturer covering epitaxy, device fabrication, and module assembly for EV power applications. Subsidiary of Chinese optical fiber maker YOFC; competes with Wolfspeed, onsemi, and STMicroelectronics in third-generation power semiconductors.
robotnik_take: Largest 2023 China semi private deal. SiC IDM with full vertical integration from epi to module assembly; targets EV power applications competing with WOLF, ON, STM in third-gen semiconductors.

company_description: Singapore NTU spinout designing radiation-hardened ICs for satellites, deep space, and high-reliability power management. Competes with Microchip and BAE in the niche rad-hard market.
co_investors: Dart Family Office
robotnik_take: Radiation-hardened ICs spun out of NTU for satellites, deep space, and high-reliability power management. Niche play in growing rad-hard market dominated by Microchip, BAE.

company_description: Chinese designer of ARM-based intelligent CPU SoCs for performance and efficiency applications. Part of China's effort to build domestic ARM-server chip alternatives to Ampere and AWS Graviton.
co_investors: Cathay Ventures, Cherami Investment Group, Nio Capital, Qiming Venture Partners
robotnik_take: Develops Arm-based intelligent CPU SoCs for performance/efficiency markets. Part of China's effort to build domestic Arm-server chip alternatives to AMPR/AVGO Nitro/Graviton.

company_description: Korean custom silicon design house leveraging Samsung Foundry SAFE Design Solution Partner status to deliver fabless ASIC services. Targets AI accelerator and SoC customers; comparable business model to Alchip and Global Unichip.
lead_investors: Korea Development Bank, Korea Investment Partners, SV Investment, Zephyrus Lab
co_investors: Shinhan Securities, Doosan
robotnik_take: Custom silicon design platform leveraging Samsung Foundry SAFE Design Solution Partner status. Korean equivalent of Alchip/GUC business model serving fabless ASIC market growing on AI demand.

company_description: Develops the SuperQ silicon power MOSFET technology, claiming 6x lower on-resistance than legacy silicon and 1.6x lower than GaN. Targets commodity power MOSFET volumes against Infineon, onsemi, and STMicroelectronics.
co_investors: Applied Ventures
robotnik_take: Silicon power devices using SuperQ technology delivering 6x lower resistance than legacy silicon and 1.6x lower than GaN. Threatens INFY/ON/STM commodity power MOSFET volumes if production scales.

company_description: Indian RISC-V processor IP startup incubated at IIT Madras. Targets Indian domestic chip design ambition under the DigiIndia program; comparable to Andes Technology in Taiwan.
robotnik_take: RISC-V processor IP startup incubated at IIT-Madras. India's domestic chip design ambition akin to Andes Tech in Taiwan; modest size but flagship Indian semiconductor venture deal under DigiIndia.

company_description: Slovak developer of the Prodigy Universal Processor, which combines CPU, GPGPU, and TPU functions on a single chip. Backed by EU IPCEI grants under European sovereign AI/HPC silicon plans.
robotnik_take: EU IPCEI grant to accelerate Prodigy 2 Universal Processor combining CPU/GPGPU/TPU functions. Part of EU's bid for sovereign AI/HPC silicon, akin to SiPearl but with broader workload ambitions.

company_description: Chinese designer of SSDs, BMC chips, and military-grade storage and computing products. Targets the Chinese defense and state IT segment; competes with Phison and Marvell at the commodity end.
co_investors: Xuchang Weidu, QingSong Fund, QF Capital
robotnik_take: Designs SSDs, BMC chips, and military-grade storage and computing products. Plays in defense/state IT segment isolated from US export controls; competes with Phison/Marvell on commodity end.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of IC chip carriers and substrates for advanced packaging. Domestic supply-chain play addressing the packaging-substrate gap currently filled by Japanese and Taiwanese suppliers.
co_investors: GF Xinde Investment
robotnik_take: Chinese chip carrier/substrate company addressing domestic packaging supply gap. Smaller bet alongside SJSemi/AaltoSemi to localize advanced packaging supply chain.

company_description: Chinese designer of power management chips for high-reliability aerospace and defense applications. Operates in the niche addressed in the West by Vicor and rad-hard Microchip products.
robotnik_take: Power management chips for high-reliability aerospace/defense applications. Niche position similar to Vicor/Microchip rad-hard products in Western market; insulated from export controls.

company_description: Designs energy-efficient ASICs for Bitcoin mining and zero-knowledge proof acceleration. Founded by alumni of Cavium and Palo Alto Networks; competes with Bitmain and MicroBT in mining hardware with a US-based design house.
co_investors: Marathon Digital Holdings, Cota Capital, DCVC, Stanford University
robotnik_take: Energy-efficient silicon for Bitcoin mining ASICs and zero-knowledge proof acceleration; Cavium/Palo Alto Networks alumni founders. Plays in Bitmain/MicroBT-dominated ASIC mining hardware market with US-based design.

company_description: Dutch fabless designer of edge AI inference chips for computer vision and LLM workloads in automotive ADAS, robotics, and industrial applications. Competes with Qualcomm, Hailo, and Intel Movidius at the edge.
co_investors: CDP Venture Capital, Verve Ventures, Fractionelera
robotnik_take: Edge AI inference chip imec spinout. Metis platform competes with Hailo/EdgeQ in vision/edge AI segment; round took total Series A to ~$50M positioning as European edge AI champion.

company_description: Provides VLSI, embedded systems, and FPGA chip design services. Acquired by Indian-listed MosChip in 2023 to consolidate India-based ASIC design services.
robotnik_take: VLSI/embedded/FPGA design services firm acquired by Indian-listed MosChip via 52.6% share-swap, 47.4% cash. Consolidates India-based ASIC services scale rivaling Tata Elxsi and HCLTech in chip design outsourcing.

company_description: Builds small geostationary communications satellites — roughly the size of a mini-fridge — that deliver dedicated broadband to specific regions at lower cost than traditional GEO sats. Operates the Omega program targeting 100+ Block 1 satellites in orbit by 2030.
co_investors: BAM Elevate, BlackRock, Fidelity Management & Research, Baillie Gifford
robotnik_take: Mega-round at $1.6B post-money to fully fund Omega program (small GEO comms sats). Comparable to ASTS satellite-direct play at MEO/LEO; Astranis goes GEO with smaller, cheaper birds. Equity + debt structure; plans 100+ Block 1 satellites in orbit by 2030.

company_description: Builds autonomous orbital vehicles (the Jackal AOV) and ground software for space domain awareness and rendezvous-proximity operations. Sells primarily to the US Space Force and Department of Defense for orbital security missions.
co_investors: Riot Ventures, Champion Hill Ventures, SpaceVC, Narya
robotnik_take: Space domain awareness / RPO startup - Jackal autonomous orbital pursuit vehicle. Defense-focused; founded by ex-Space Force operators. Direct comp: Rocket Lab's space surveillance services and Slingshot Aerospace.

company_description: Japanese lunar exploration company developing the HAKUTO-R lunar lander and Series 3 lander for cislunar cargo missions. Listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (9348). Not to be confused with the Chinese launch company iSpace / Beijing Interstellar Glory.
robotnik_take: Lunar lander developer; first Japanese lunar startup to IPO (Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market). Raised JPY 6.7B on debut, traded ~4x offering price. Hakuto-R Mission 1 lander failed at touchdown weeks later. Comp: Intuitive Machines (LUNR-Nasdaq) post-SPAC, Astrobotic.

company_description: Operates an optical inter-satellite data relay constellation that provides bandwidth backhaul for other LEO operators. Differentiated from voice/IoT comms providers; partnered with the US Space Development Agency on Tranche 0/1 missions.
co_investors: Costanoa Ventures, Canaan Partners, Tribe Capital, BDC Capital Industrial Innovation Venture Fund
robotnik_take: Optical inter-satellite data relay constellation - bandwidth backhaul for other LEO operators. Differentiated from Iridium-style voice/IoT comms; more like 'space-internet plumbing'. Total raised >$200M post round. Ties to SDA Tranche 0/1 ecosystem.

company_description: Builds in-space refueling infrastructure — propellant depots and shuttle vehicles for refueling satellites in GEO, LEO, and VLEO. Lockheed Martin Ventures is a strategic investor anchoring defense prime interest.
co_investors: Stride Capital, Industrious Ventures, Lockheed Martin Ventures, Tribe Capital, Good Growth Capital, Massive Capital Partners
robotnik_take: On-orbit refueling; fuel depots in GEO/LEO/VLEO. Lockheed Martin Ventures participation signals primes' interest in in-orbit servicing. Adjacent to Astroscale's debris/servicing, but Orbit Fab focuses purely on propellant/fuel.

company_description: Operates a thermal-infrared earth observation constellation for agriculture, water management, and climate monitoring. Competes with Constellr and Satellite Vu in commercial thermal EO; commodities trader Hartree Partners is a strategic investor.
co_investors: Blue Bear Capital, Hartree Partners, OTB Ventures, Freeflow Ventures, Cultivation Capital, Techstars, Santa Barbara Venture Partners, Expon Capital, Hemisphere Ventures
robotnik_take: Thermal-IR EO for ag/water/climate. $20M total announcement included $5M non-dilutive grants. Direct comp to Constellr (DE) and Satellite Vu (UK) - thermal-only EO category is consolidating around 3-4 players globally. Strategic Hartree Partners (commodities trader) anchor signals ag-fintech use case.

company_description: Builds liquid rocket engines as an independent supplier, including the Hadley (small launch class) and Ripley (medium-lift) engines. Customers include ABL Space Systems, Stratolaunch, and Phantom Space; growing hypersonic and defense propulsion lines.
co_investors: Space Capital, Explorer 1 Fund, Eclipse Ventures
robotnik_take: Independent rocket engine maker - Hadley (small launch) and Ripley (medium-lift) propulsion. Customers include ABL, Stratolaunch, Phantom Space. ~$400M pre-money valuation. Hypersonic/defense exposure adds to commercial launch story; comparable to Aerojet Rocketdyne's commercial offering, but newspace-style.

company_description: Bulgarian satellite platform provider offering modular smallsat buses, in-orbit services, and turnkey mission delivery. Competes with York Space Systems and other commercial smallsat manufacturers.
co_investors: Freigeist Capital
robotnik_take: Smallsat/CubeSat platform builder; pivoting to constellation-as-a-service. 2,500+ systems flown. Bulgarian space tech with EU venture backing - rare CEE space exit candidate.

company_description: UK developer of the HotSat-1 thermal-infrared earth observation constellation. Sells thermal imagery for energy efficiency, climate monitoring, and industrial applications; competes with Constellr in the thermal-only EO segment.
co_investors: Seraphim Space, Lockheed Martin, A/O Proptech, Earth Sciences Foundation, Stellar Ventures, Ridgeline Partners
robotnik_take: Thermal-IR EO startup ('HotSat-1' constellation). Series A2 extension brought total to GBP 30.5M. GBP 128M of pre-launch customer commitments. Comp to Constellr (DE) thermal-only play; addresses energy/climate monitoring vs broad EO of MAXR/Planet.

company_description: Mobile-first satellite imagery marketplace aggregating tasking and archive imagery from over 50 EO satellite operators. Downstream data-distribution play rather than constellation owner.
co_investors: J2 Ventures, Moving Capital, Bill Perkins
robotnik_take: Mobile-first satellite imagery marketplace - 'Uber for satellite tasking.' Aggregates 50+ EO partners. Differentiated downstream play - data aggregation/distribution layer rather than constellation owner. Comp: SkyWatch (CA), UP42 (Airbus).

company_description: Provides Bluetooth-to-satellite connectivity for IoT and asset tracking — operates a constellation that lets standard Bluetooth Low Energy devices communicate directly with satellites. Targets massive low-bandwidth tracking use cases.
co_investors: Y Combinator, Yes.VC, Convective Capital, Seraphim Space, Type One Ventures, Soma Capital, AVCF5, SpaceVC, 11.2 Capital
robotnik_take: Bluetooth-to-satellite for IoT/asset tracking - direct-to-device pure-play targeting massive low-bandwidth use cases. Adjacent to Lynk/AST SpaceMobile but at the BLE physical layer; novel low-power approach.

company_description: Indian space company operating the Firefly hyperspectral satellite constellation. Sells hyperspectral imagery to agriculture, mining, energy, and government customers as the highest-funded hyperspectral pure-play globally.
co_investors: Google, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Blume Ventures, growX, Sparta, Athera
robotnik_take: Hyperspectral EO play; Google's first Indian space investment. Differentiated from MAXR/Planet (multispectral) on spectral resolution. Funds Aurora analytics platform plus Firefly constellation buildout.

company_description: Operates a proprietary weather satellite constellation and provides hyper-local weather prediction and analytics to enterprise customers. Targets aviation, logistics, energy, and government users with AI-native forecasts.
co_investors: RTX Ventures, Seraphim Space, Chemonics, SquarePeg Capital, Canaan Partners, ClearVision, JetBlue Ventures, Pitango Growth
robotnik_take: Weather-radar smallsat constellation + AI weather forecasting. Closed in tandem with Tomorrow-R2 satellite launch from Vandenberg. RTX Ventures (Lockheed) participation. Vertical integration play - own data via own birds. Adjacent to Spire (also weather/RO).

company_description: German space situational awareness company building a 12-satellite constellation with optical sensors for in-orbit object detection in LEO. Safran is a strategic investor; competes with LeoLabs, NorthStar, and Aldoria.
co_investors: Happiness Capital, Atlantic Labs, Faber Ventures
robotnik_take: Space-based SSA - building 12-satellite constellation for object detection in LEO with optical sensors. Safran (defense prime) strategic involvement signals defense angle. EUR 8.5M tranche topped up earlier seed; total >EUR 10M post round. Comps: LeoLabs, NorthStar, Aldoria.

company_description: Manufactures productized 100 kg-class Aries satellite buses on a serial production line in Los Angeles. Customers include Orbit Fab, Ubotica, and defense primes; competes with York Space Systems and Loft Orbital in standardized smallsat platforms.
co_investors: Shield Capital, J2 Ventures, XYZ Venture Capital, CRV, Toyota Ventures, Robinhood co-founder Baiju Bhatt
robotnik_take: Productized 100kg Aries satellite-bus manufacturer. Customer roster: Orbit Fab, Ubotica, defense prime. Direct competitor: York Space Systems, Loft Orbital. New 50,000 sq ft LA factory targets cycle-time/cost reductions on a productized SKU.

company_description: Solid rocket motor (SRM) manufacturer using proprietary aluminum-lithium ALITEC fuel. Acquired by Anduril in 2023 to enter the SRM supply market for hypersonics, missiles, and space launch.
robotnik_take: Anduril's entry into solid rocket motor (SRM) supply for hypersonics, missiles, and space launch. Adranos's proprietary aluminum-lithium ALITEC fuel; Mississippi production complex. Deal terms undisclosed. Strategic move to break SRM duopoly (Northrop/L3-Aerojet). Signals defense-tech roll-up wave - similar to Anduril's Adranos + Numerica strategy.

company_description: Direct lithium extraction company using its LiTAS molecular-separation membrane technology to recover lithium from brines without evaporation ponds. GM is a strategic investor and offtake partner.
co_investors: POSCO Holdings, University of Texas Horizon Fund, Helios Capital
robotnik_take: Direct lithium extraction (DLE) using LiTAS membranes; claims 90%+ recovery vs. 30-40% conventional. GM strategic to lock in domestic lithium supply for Ultium platform. Positions against ALB and LAC traditional brine players via process tech rather than orebody quality.

company_description: Dutch developer of a nano-porous silicon anode material for lithium-ion batteries, produced through a low-cost casting process. Norsk Hydro is a strategic investor integrating its aluminum value chain into European battery supply.
co_investors: Invest-NL, Rubio, SHIFT Invest, PDENH (with €5.5M Dutch National Growth Fund subsidy)
robotnik_take: Nano-porous silicon anode material; differentiated from Sila/Group14 by casting-based process for lower cost. Norsk Hydro strategic to integrate aluminum value chain into European battery supply. €15M equity Series A; thesis fit is European-onshored anode capacity vs. Asian incumbents.

company_description: Chinese cathode active material manufacturer producing LFP and NCM cathodes for the lithium-ion battery industry. Supplies major Chinese cell makers including CATL and BYD; anchored strategically by automaker GAC ahead of Hong Kong/mainland IPO.
co_investors: GAC Capital, Yibin Development Holdings Group, GEM, China Capital Management, Royal-Power Asset Management, +13 others
robotnik_take: Cathode materials manufacturer scaling LFP and NCM capacity ahead of HK/Mainland IPO process. ¥2.6B Series B is one of largest battery materials raises of 2023, anchored by GAC's strategic capital. Sits in same value-chain pocket as ALB-type cathode-active-material producers serving CATL/BYD.

company_description: Recycles rare-earth permanent magnets from end-of-life EV motors, wind turbines, and hard drives using its Mag-Cycle process. Operates Hub100, a first commercial demonstration facility, as a circular alternative to primary rare earth mining.
lead_investors: BMW i Ventures, Energy Impact Partners
co_investors: Fifth Wall, Bioindustrial Innovation Canada (BIC), Planetary Technologies
robotnik_take: Rare earth element recycling (Mag-Cycle process) for permanent magnets in EV motors and wind turbines. BMW i Ventures co-lead is an OEM supply-chain signal; first commercial demo facility (Hub100). Direct alternative to MP Materials' primary mining model — circular recovery from end-of-life motors and HDDs.

company_description: Industrial water treatment and resource recovery company with a growing critical-minerals practice. The CFRO and CFRO+ processes are used for lithium concentration from brines and oilfield wastewater. Sells to mining, semiconductor, and refining customers globally.
co_investors: Schlumberger, Warburg Pincus
robotnik_take: Industrial water treatment with growing lithium / critical minerals extraction practice (CFRO/CFRO+ for brines). Crossed unicorn status; capital deployed to MENA/EU expansion and lithium DLE production tooling. Adjacent to ALB and LAC brine processing economics; differentiated water-side stack vs. EnergyX's membranes.

company_description: Develops lithium-sulfur EV battery cells using its 3D Graphene supermaterial platform. Cobalt- and nickel-free chemistry positioned as an alternative to Asian NMC and LFP cell incumbents; Stellantis is a strategic investor and offtake partner.
robotnik_take: Lithium-sulfur EV battery startup; Stellantis Ventures strategic investment to advance Lyten's 3D Graphene supermaterial platform. Anchor placement in what later closed as $200M Series B in Sept 2023; cobalt/nickel-free chemistry positions Lyten as differentiated alternative to Asian cell incumbents.

company_description: Uses atomic layer deposition (ALD) to coat battery cathode and anode materials for higher performance and longer life. Operates a 1 GWh pilot battery line for premium aerospace, defense, and consumer applications; supply agreement with 6K's PlusCAM.
co_investors: Orion Infrastructure Capital (OIC), Catalus Capital, Ascent Funds, plus existing investors
robotnik_take: Atomic layer deposition (ALD) coating for battery materials; 1 GWh pilot battery line in Q2 2023 for premium aerospace/defense/CE applications. Hanwha lead reflects Korean cell-maker pipeline (Forge has supply agreement with 6K's PlusCAM). Process-tech enabler rather than active material — sits closer to materials equipment vs. ALB/MP comp set.

company_description: Uses machine-learning models to identify and develop deposits of copper, lithium, nickel, and cobalt globally. Flagship project is the Mingomba copper deposit in Zambia; the company exists at the intersection of AI-driven exploration software and traditional mining operations.
co_investors: Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND, Standard Investments, Equinor Ventures, BHP Ventures, Mitsubishi Corporation, Earthshot Ventures, July Fund
robotnik_take: AI-powered mineral exploration for cobalt/copper/nickel/lithium. Crossed unicorn status. Direct play on rare earth/critical minerals discovery for EV battery supply chain. Primary public comps: MP Materials, USAR. AI/ML applied to physical exploration is differentiated thesis.

company_description: Vertically integrated lithium-ion battery cell manufacturer for European automotive and grid storage markets. Operated gigafactories in Sweden and Germany; held battery recycling capacity through subsidiaries Revolt and lithium-metal IP through Cuberg before filing for bankruptcy in November 2024.
robotnik_take: Convertible notes from Ontario pension giant IMCO; capital earmarked for North American expansion ahead of Aug 2023 $1.2B convertible. Pre-bankruptcy peak; would later be eclipsed by collapse in Nov 2024. Massive vertically-integrated EU gigafactory play; battery materials adjacency through Cuberg/Revolt recycling assets.

company_description: Builds a biometric proof-of-personhood network combining the Orb iris-scanning device, the World ID identity credential, and the WLD token. Co-founded by Sam Altman; targets identity verification for the AI era.
co_investors: a16z crypto, Bain Capital Crypto, Distributed Global, Khosla Ventures
robotnik_take: Sam Altman-cofounded biometric ID + WLD token network. Hardware-anchored DePIN play (Orb iris-scan device) — unique among AI/identity tokens for its physical infrastructure layer. Capital deployed pre-WLD TGE in July 2023. Core thesis: proof-of-personhood for AI age. Robotnik fit: physical sensor network grafted onto crypto incentives.

company_description: Decentralized GPU compute marketplace for machine learning training, structured as a protocol with token-incentivized capacity providers. Targets the same use case as Akash, Render, and io.net in the AI-compute DePIN segment.
co_investors: Protocol Labs, CoinFund, Canonical Crypto, Eden Block, Maven 11
robotnik_take: Decentralized GPU/compute marketplace for ML training; protocol-native pay-on-demand for distributed training. Pure compute-infra Frontier Compute thesis fit — token-incentivized hardware utilization beats centralized cloud economics. a16z lead validates as flagship of the AI-x-crypto compute layer alongside Akash, Render, io.net.

company_description: Manufactures autonomous drones for public safety, defense, and industrial inspection, with onboard AI for obstacle avoidance and tracking. Sunset its consumer drone line in 2023 to focus on enterprise and government customers; more than half of its pipeline is defense-related.
co_investors: Andreessen Horowitz, Next47, IVP, DoCoMo, NVIDIA, UP.Partners, Hercules Capital, Axon
robotnik_take: Largest US drone maker raised at $2.2B post-money — total funding now $562M. The Axon investment signals deeper public-safety penetration as Skydio leans into enterprise/DoD over consumer.

company_description: Norwegian humanoid robot company building NEO, a consumer-oriented bipedal android designed for the home. Strategic and product collaboration with OpenAI; competes with Figure and Tesla Optimus on consumer humanoid form factors.
co_investors: Tiger Global Management, Sandwater, Alliance Ventures, Skagerak Capital
robotnik_take: OpenAI's first robotics bet — funding goes to NEO bipedal humanoid development and EVE manufacturing scale-up. Marks the start of OpenAI's strategic interest in physical AI hardware.

company_description: Builds autonomous yard trucks with integrated robotic arms for hooking and unhooking trailers at distribution centers. Deployed at customers covering about 20% of the North American yard-truck base.
co_investors: Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, NVentures (NVIDIA), Koch Disruptive Technologies, NEA
robotnik_take: Autonomous electric yard truck developer. NVIDIA Ventures participation signals strategic interest in distribution-yard automation as the wedge for trucking autonomy.

company_description: UK-based B2B autonomous driving software platform. Customers and partners include insurance, energy, and logistics operators deploying autonomous vehicles in industrial settings; Tencent is a strategic investor.
lead_investors: Aioi Nissay Dowa Insurance, ENEOS Innovation Partners
co_investors: BGF, Halma, Hostplus, Kiko Ventures, Ocado Group, Tencent, Venture Science, ZF
robotnik_take: B2B autonomy software platform. Tencent's participation signals strategic Chinese interest in UK AV stack. Insurance and energy LP composition reflects industrial-deployment ambitions.

company_description: Builds autonomous electric commercial mowers for landscape contractors and grounds-maintenance operators. Subscription-based deployment model with more than 7,500 preorders booked.
co_investors: ArcTern Ventures, Alumni Ventures, Amazon Alexa Fund, True Ventures, Inspired Capital, Lemnos
robotnik_take: Autonomous electric commercial mower vendor with 7,500 preorders. Outdoor-autonomy thesis is gaining traction as a high-volume, lower-regulatory-friction wedge vs full AVs.

company_description: Slovak company combining Photoneo (3D machine vision) and Brightpick (autonomous warehouse picking) into an integrated vision-and-robotics warehouse automation stack. Sells to European warehouse and 3PL operators.
co_investors: IPM Group, Alpha Intelligence Capital, H&D Asset Management, Venture to Future Fund, Kolowrat Group
robotnik_take: $19M extension brings Series B to $40M for the merged Photoneo (3D vision) + Brightpick (autonomous warehouse picking). Total raised $53M. Vision-stack + robot-fleet integration thesis playing out in EU.

company_description: Builds the Ago automotive radar software platform that improves ADAS radar resolution and reduces false positives without changing the underlying radar hardware. Microsoft is a strategic investor.
co_investors: Microsoft, Prime Movers Lab, MaC VC, Gaingels
robotnik_take: Automotive radar software (Ago platform) targeting ADAS resolution and false-positive reduction. Microsoft's participation suggests cloud/compute partnership angle alongside the core sensor-software product.

company_description: Israeli developer of teleoperation software for autonomous vehicles — remote-supervision middleware that lets human operators take over self-driving cars when needed. ComfortDelGro is a strategic transit-operator investor.
co_investors: Mizmaa Ventures, IN Venture, Next Gear Ventures
robotnik_take: Largest-ever Series A for a teleoperation pure-play. ComfortDelGro's $4M anchor investment signals Asian transit operator interest in remote-supervision middleware as a path to AV deployment.

company_description: French developer of a co-manipulated robotic assistant for total knee arthroplasty. Targets European CE-mark approval for orthopedic surgical robotics.
co_investors: Cap Horn, Bpifrance
robotnik_take: EUR 15M extension brings Series B total to EUR 36M for orthopedic surgical robot maker. Funds development of co-manipulated robotic assistant for total knee arthroplasty ahead of CE-mark.

company_description: German construction robotics company building the LIFTBOT material-transport robot that automates scaffold logistics and site material delivery. Targets construction sites with high labor turnover.
co_investors: Cybernetix Ventures, Unorthodox Ventures, Nemetschek, True Ventures, MIG Capital
robotnik_take: Construction-site robotics (LiftBot hoist). Fifth Wall lead reflects real-estate-aligned LP base betting on construction productivity automation.

company_description: Singapore-based manufacturer of commercial cleaning robots for offices, retail, and large indoor facilities. Sells globally with growing US distribution.
co_investors: Supersteam Asia Pacific, Freny Firoze Irani
robotnik_take: Cleaning robot manufacturer at $80M pre-money valuation. TransLink's $7M check signals US VC interest in commercial-cleaning automation as proven-revenue category vs more speculative humanoid bets.

company_description: Japanese industrial drone services and software company. Saudi Aramco's venture arm led a strategic round to establish Terra Drone Arabia under Saudi Vision 2030, focused on industrial-inspection drone services.
robotnik_take: Aramco's VC arm led the round to set up Terra Drone Arabia under Saudi Vision 2030. Reflects Saudi industrial-inspection drone ambition and Japanese-Saudi tech corridor.

company_description: French manufacturer of the Colossus firefighting unmanned ground vehicle, deployed at the Notre-Dame fire. More than 100 robots deployed in 15 countries for hostile-environment robotics applications.
robotnik_take: Maker of Colossus firefighting UGV (deployed at Notre-Dame fire) raises EUR 10M for hostile-environment robotics expansion. >100 robots in 15 countries — defense and emergency-services flywheel.

company_description: Builds Apollo, a general-purpose humanoid robot for warehouse and manufacturing work. Partnered with Mercedes-Benz for factory pilot deployments; targets logistics and automotive industrial customers.
robotnik_take: Pre-Apollo funding for the UT Austin spinout (Series A would not close until 2025 at $1.75B val). Early signal of mounting commercial humanoid interest before Figure/1X dominated headlines.

company_description: Develops grocery micro-fulfillment robotics including refrigerated and frozen-capable robotic picking systems. First deployment with Save Mart in California; differentiated from Symbotic and AutoStore on temperature-controlled handling.
co_investors: Khosla Ventures, DCVC
robotnik_take: Stealth-emergence Series B for grocery micro-fulfillment robotics — first deployment with Save Mart in California. Refrigerated/frozen-capable picking is the differentiator vs Symbotic/AutoStore.

company_description: Bulgarian developer of the Black Swan cargo drone, which carries 350 kg over 2,500 km — operating as the first licensed cargo-drone airline in Europe. Targets middle-mile logistics for time-sensitive cargo.
co_investors: Founders Factory, Speedinvest, SeedBlink, Eleven Capital, Strategic Development Fund (Tawazun)
robotnik_take: First licensed cargo-drone airline in Europe — Black Swan UAV carries 350kg over 2,500km. UAE Tawazun investment plus EIC commitment positions Dronamics for European middle-mile logistics.

company_description: Builds the DroneHunter kinetic counter-drone interceptor and the SkyDome radar system. Strategic backers Lockheed Martin and Hanwha provide defense channel access; sells counter-UAS systems to militaries and critical infrastructure operators.
lead_investors: Lockheed Martin Ventures, Hanwha Aerospace, AIM13|Crumpton Venture Partners
co_investors: DCVC, Signia Venture Partners
robotnik_take: Counter-UAS systems play (DroneHunter kinetic interceptor) gets Lockheed and Hanwha as strategic backers. Defense-tech tailwind amid Ukraine drone war is bringing strategic capital into C-UAS.

company_description: Indian manufacturer of dual-use drones for agricultural spraying, mapping, and defense applications. MS Dhoni is a brand-ambassador investor; benefits from India's drone PLI scheme.
robotnik_take: Largest-ever Series A in Indian drone space — MS Dhoni-backed dual-use drone maker. India's drone PLI scheme is creating real domestic VC enthusiasm for defense/agriculture UAVs.

company_description: Drone-based inspection and analytics company (formerly DroneBase) specializing in energy infrastructure — solar farms, wind turbines, power lines, and oil and gas assets. Sells data and AI-based analytics to asset owners.
co_investors: Union Square Ventures, Upfront Ventures, Euclidean Capital, Energy Transition Ventures, Hearst Ventures
robotnik_take: Drone-data company (formerly DroneBase) rebrand and Series E around energy-asset inspection. Plays into renewables-infrastructure inspection demand alongside Skydio/AeroVironment.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of service robots for delivery and cleaning applications, with more than 56,000 units shipped across 60+ countries. (Same parent organization as Pudu Robotics; this row covers an earlier funding round.)
robotnik_take: Service-robot maker (delivery + cleaning) C3 round funds new production base. >56,000 units shipped in 60+ countries — leading Chinese commercial service-robot vendor.

company_description: Wyss Zurich spinout building a magnetically controlled medical soft-robotic platform for stroke thrombectomy. Uses a mobile electromagnetic field generator to steer guidewires endovascularly.
co_investors: Kinled Holding, Mountain Labs
